title: Beyond Masks and Trajectories: Flow-Guided Latent Action Injection for Stable Surgical Video Generation
title_zh: FLAIR - 超越掩码与轨迹：基于流引导的潜在动作注入，实现稳定的手术视频生成

paragraphs.en: Surgical video generation holds substantial potential for surgical education, simulation, and data augmentation, yet generating surgical videos with realistic and clinically plausible motion remains challenging. Most existing methods rely on auxiliary conditions, such as masks, trajectories, depth, or reference videos, to achieve visually plausible synthesis. Yet, these auxiliary conditions typically require additional manual annotation or specialized acquisition, making it difficult to scale such methods beyond small, curated datasets. This motivates the need for a reference-free architecture capable of generating high-quality surgical video without requiring auxiliary visual conditions at inference time. We propose FLAIR , a F low-guided L atent A ction I njection framework for R eference-free surgical video generation. FLAIR learns action priors from optical flow of real surgical videos, dynamically predicts corresponding latent action representation from an input prompt, and injects it into a frozen base model to generate surgical videos with improved action consistency. We further construct SurgActionClip-30K , the first large-scale surgical vision dataset comprising action-centric segmented clips and structured caption labels, addressing the persistent lack of fine-grained, action-centric surgical datasets. Lastly, we introduce SurgMetrics , the first surgical domain-specific evaluation metrics for quantifying the quality of generated surgical videos, addressing the persistent absence of clinically grounded evaluation standards in this domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLAIR enables generating high-quality surgical videos using text-only inference without auxiliary conditions, and validation in SurgMetrics demonstrates its strength in alignment with human perception compared to traditional metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 手术视频生成在外科教育、模拟和数据增强方面具有巨大潜力，但要生成具有真实感且临床合理的手术视频仍然充满挑战。 大多数现有方法依赖辅助条件（如掩码、轨迹、深度或参考视频）来实现视觉上合理的合成。 然而，这些辅助条件通常需要额外的人工标注或专门的采集过程，导致此类方法难以超越小型的精选数据集进行扩展应用。 这促使我们开发一种无需参考的架构，能够在推理阶段不依赖任何辅助视觉条件的情况下生成高质量的手术视频。 我们提出了 FLAIR——一个基于流引导潜在动作注入的无参考手术视频生成框架。 FLAIR 从真实手术视频的光流中学习动作先验，动态地从输入提示中预测对应的潜在动作表示，并将其注入到冻结的基础模型中，从而生成动作一致性更强的手术视频。 我们进一步构建了 SurgActionClip-30K——首个大规模手术视觉数据集，包含以动作为核心的分割片段和结构化标题标签，解决了精细且以动作为中心的手术数据集长期缺失的问题。 最后，我们引入了 SurgMetrics——首个面向手术领域的专用评估指标，用于量化生成手术视频的质量，填补了该领域缺乏临床依据的评估标准的空白。 大量实验表明，FLAIR 能够仅通过文本输入进行推理，无需辅助条件即可生成高质量的手术视频；SurgMetrics 的验证结果也证明，与传统指标相比，FLAIR 在契合人类感知方面表现更优。

paragraphs.en: Surgical videos are widely used in medical education, skill assessment, and the development of downstream surgical AI systems [ 25 , 8 , 16 ] . Unlike general-domain videos, they contain procedure-constrained actions and fine-grained instrument-tissue interactions in which small motion deviations can alter clinical meaning [ 27 ] . Existing recordings are mostly long and untrimmed, lacking action-centric clips for learning motion patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 手术视频被广泛用于医学教育、技能评估以及下游手术人工智能系统的发展 [ 25 , 8 , 16 ] 。 与通用领域的视频不同，手术视频包含受流程约束的动作以及精细的手术器械与组织相互作用，其中微小的运动偏差就可能改变临床意义 [ 27 ] 。 现有的录像大多未经剪辑且时长较长，缺乏以动作为核心的片段来学习运动模式。

sents.en: Surgical videos are widely used in medical education, skill assessment, and the development of downstream surgical AI systems [ 25 , 8 , 16 ] .
sents.zh: 手术视频被广泛用于医学教育、技能评估以及下游手术人工智能系统的发展 [ 25 , 8 , 16 ] 。

sents.zh: 现有的录像大多未经剪辑且时长较长，缺乏以动作为核心的片段来学习运动模式。

paragraphs.en: Recent surgical video generation methods mainly adapt general-domain generative models to surgical scenes through domain fine-tuning, text-guided diffusion, or additional structural conditioning [ 21 , 7 , 23 , 5 , 3 , 29 ] . While these approaches have demonstrated the feasibility of surgical video synthesis and achieved improved visual realism and controllability, their controllability is often achieved through explicit inference-time conditions, including reference frames, segmentation masks, depth maps, or tool trajectories [ 48 , 32 , 5 , 3 , 29 ] , which are costly to obtain and unavailable in many low-resource educational or clinical settings [ 45 ] . This raises the need for reference-free, text-only motion guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的手术视频生成方法主要通过领域微调、文本引导扩散或额外的结构条件约束，将通用领域的生成模型适配到手术场景中 [ 21 , 7 , 23 , 5 , 3 , 29 ] 。 尽管这些方法已证明了手术视频合成的可行性，并实现了更佳的视觉真实性和可控性，但其可控性通常依赖于推理阶段的显式条件，例如参考帧、分割掩码、深度图或工具轨迹 [ 48 , 32 , 5 , 3 , 29 ] ，而这些条件的获取成本高昂，且在许多资源匮乏的教育或临床环境中并不可用 [ 45 ] 。 因此，亟需一种无需参考图像、仅通过文本即可引导运动的方法。

sents.en: This raises the need for reference-free, text-only motion guidance.
sents.zh: 因此，亟需一种无需参考图像、仅通过文本即可引导运动的方法。

paragraphs.en: Short action-centric clips make this problem tractable. Relative to the broad motion space of general-domain videos, surgical videos occupy a substantially narrower region constrained by anatomy, instrument affordances, and procedural workflow. Within this domain, instances of a specific action concentrate further into a compact action-conditioned region, allowing text alone to select a plausible motion mode without predicting arbitrary frame-level dynamics. Text therefore only needs to identify the intended action and map it to this restricted region, while the action’s canonical execution paradigm can be learned from recurring examples in real surgical videos.
paragraphs.zh: 简短的动作导向片段使这个问题变得可处理。 与通用领域视频中广泛的动作空间相比，手术视频占据的区域要狭窄得多，受到解剖结构、器械可用性以及操作流程的严格限制。 在这一领域中，特定动作的实例会进一步集中在一个紧凑的动作条件区域，这使得仅凭文本就能选择合理的运动模式，而无需预测任意的帧级动态变化。 因此，文本只需识别预期的动作并将其映射到这个受限区域，而该动作的标准执行范式则可以通过真实手术视频中反复出现的示例来学习。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by the observation that optical flow naturally deemphasizes static background while highlighting the motion of surgical interactions in videos, we propose FLAIR , a F low-guided L atent A ction I njection framework for R eference-free surgical video generation. This framework introduces motion priors learned from real surgical videos into a text-to-video diffusion model, allowing text prompts to guide surgical video generation without requiring auxiliary inference-time conditions. Specifically, FLAIR first learns compact surgical action embeddings from optical flow, then trains a text-to-action predictor to map surgical prompts into the learned latent action space. The predicted action embedding is injected into a frozen diffusion Transformer through a lightweight adapter, providing motion guidance during generation without relying on masks, trajectories, depth maps, or reference videos. Experiments show that FLAIR improves motion stability and action consistency over domain-adapted baselines, demonstrating that text prompts can guide not only the appearance but also the motion of surgical video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 受这样一个观察结果的启发：光流在自然状态下会弱化静态背景，同时突出视频中手术操作的动态变化，我们提出了 FLAIR——一种基于光流引导的潜在动作注入框架，用于无需参考视频的手术视频生成。 该框架将真实手术视频中学习到的运动先验引入文本到视频的扩散模型中，使得文本提示能够指导手术视频的生成，而无需在推理阶段依赖辅助条件。 具体而言，FLAIR 首先从光流中学习紧凑的手术动作嵌入表示，然后训练一个文本到动作的预测器，将手术提示映射到学习到的潜在动作空间中。 预测的动作嵌入通过一个轻量级适配器注入到冻结的扩散 Transformer 中，在生成过程中提供运动指导，而无需依赖掩码、轨迹、深度图或参考视频。 实验表明，FLAIR 相较于经过领域自适应的基线模型，在运动稳定性和动作一致性方面均有提升，证明了文本提示不仅能指导手术视频的外观生成，还能引导其运动表现。

paragraphs.en: In summary, this work makes the following contributions: (1) We propose FLAIR , a framework that learns flow-derived latent action priors during training and enables reference-free, text-only inference without auxiliary conditions. (2) We construct SurgActionClip-30K , the first large-scale surgical video dataset with action-centric segmentation and template-guided captions. (3) We introduce SurgMetrics , the first objective evaluation metrics tailored for surgical video generation, which provide domain-specific measurements with six artifact-specific scores and an independent domain-typicality score. (4) Extensive experiments across standard metrics and SurgMetrics demonstrate that FLAIR consistently improves motion stability, action consistency, and surgical-domain plausibility over existing baselines, supporting the feasibility of text-only surgical video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本研究做出了以下贡献：(1) 我们提出了 FLAIR——一个在训练过程中学习流衍生潜在动作先验的框架，它无需参考条件，仅凭文本即可进行推理。 (2) 我们构建了 SurgActionClip-30K——首个以动作为核心、包含分割和模板引导式标题的大型手术视频数据集。 (3) 我们引入了 SurgMetrics——首个专为手术视频生成设计的客观评估指标，它提供了六个针对特定伪影的评分以及一个独立的领域典型性评分，从而实现了领域特定的测量。 (4) 通过标准指标和 SurgMetrics 进行的广泛实验表明，FLAIR 在运动稳定性、动作一致性和手术领域的合理性方面均持续优于现有基线模型，证明了仅凭文本生成手术视频的可行性。

paragraphs.en: Existing surgical vision datasets can be broadly categorized into two paradigms. The first consists of raw, procedure-level datasets such as Cholec80 [ 35 ] , SurgicalActions160 [ 30 ] , and AutoLaparo [ 41 ] , which provide long, untrimmed recordings. These datasets’ unsegmented nature renders them ill-suited for downstream generative training. A second paradigm addresses this limitation by segmenting and re-organizing raw surgical recordings into shorter, concentrated samples. Surg-396K [ 39 ] aggregates three sources into instruction-style image-text pairs, while SurgLaVi [ 28 ] curates nearly 240K narrative clip-caption pairs and organizes them hierarchically by task and step. Similar datasets, including SurgAtlas [ 2 ] , SurgVLM-DB [ 49 ] , and Surg-QA [ 22 ] , further extend this direction by scaling up data and enriching captions. Yet, they are still either uncaptioned or segmented in ways that fail to align with discrete action boundaries, leaving none with the precision and specificity required for fine-grained, action-centric downstream training. SurgActionClip-30K addresses this gap by consolidating diverse surgical sources into a unified collection of action-centric clips with standardized textual descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的手术视觉数据集可大致分为两种范式。 第一种范式由原始的手术流程级数据集组成，例如 Cholec80 [ 35 ]、SurgicalActions160 [ 30 ] 和 AutoLaparo [ 41 ]，这些数据集提供了未经剪辑的长段记录。 由于这些数据集未进行分段，因此不适用于下游生成式训练任务。 第二种范式通过分段并重新组织原始手术记录为更短、更集中的样本，解决了这一局限性。 Surg-396K [ 39 ] 整合了三种来源的数据，形成了指令风格的图像-文本对；而 SurgLaVi [ 28 ] 则整理了近 24 万个叙事性片段-标题对，并按任务与步骤进行层级组织。 类似的数据集，包括 SurgAtlas [ 2 ]、SurgVLM-DB [ 49 ] 和 Surg-QA [ 22 ]，通过扩大数据规模并丰富文本描述，进一步拓展了这一方向。 然而，这些数据集要么没有添加文本描述，要么其分段方式未能与离散动作的边界对齐，因此没有任何一个具备精细、以动作为核心的下游训练所需的精确性与特异性。 SurgActionClip-30K 通过整合多种手术来源的数据，构建了一个统一的动作导向型片段集合，并为其配备了标准化的文本描述，从而填补了这一空白。

sents.en: Existing surgical vision datasets can be broadly categorized into two paradigms.
sents.zh: 现有的手术视觉数据集可大致分为两种范式。

sents.en: The first consists of raw, procedure-level datasets such as Cholec80 [ 35 ] , SurgicalActions160 [ 30 ] , and AutoLaparo [ 41 ] , which provide long, untrimmed recordings.
sents.zh: 第一种范式由原始的手术流程级数据集组成，例如 Cholec80 [ 35 ]、SurgicalActions160 [ 30 ] 和 AutoLaparo [ 41 ]，这些数据集提供了未经剪辑的长段记录。

sents.en: These datasets’ unsegmented nature renders them ill-suited for downstream generative training.
sents.zh: 由于这些数据集未进行分段，因此不适用于下游生成式训练任务。

sents.en: A second paradigm addresses this limitation by segmenting and re-organizing raw surgical recordings into shorter, concentrated samples.
sents.zh: 第二种范式通过分段并重新组织原始手术记录为更短、更集中的样本，解决了这一局限性。

sents.en: Surg-396K [ 39 ] aggregates three sources into instruction-style image-text pairs, while SurgLaVi [ 28 ] curates nearly 240K narrative clip-caption pairs and organizes them hierarchically by task and step.
sents.zh: Surg-396K [ 39 ] 整合了三种来源的数据，形成了指令风格的图像-文本对；而 SurgLaVi [ 28 ] 则整理了近 24 万个叙事性片段-标题对，并按任务与步骤进行层级组织。

sents.en: Similar datasets, including SurgAtlas [ 2 ] , SurgVLM-DB [ 49 ] , and Surg-QA [ 22 ] , further extend this direction by scaling up data and enriching captions.
sents.zh: 类似的数据集，包括 SurgAtlas [ 2 ]、SurgVLM-DB [ 49 ] 和 Surg-QA [ 22 ]，通过扩大数据规模并丰富文本描述，进一步拓展了这一方向。

sents.en: Yet, they are still either uncaptioned or segmented in ways that fail to align with discrete action boundaries, leaving none with the precision and specificity required for fine-grained, action-centric downstream training.
sents.zh: 然而，这些数据集要么没有添加文本描述，要么其分段方式未能与离散动作的边界对齐，因此没有任何一个具备精细、以动作为核心的下游训练所需的精确性与特异性。

sents.en: SurgActionClip-30K addresses this gap by consolidating diverse surgical sources into a unified collection of action-centric clips with standardized textual descriptions.
sents.zh: SurgActionClip-30K 通过整合多种手术来源的数据，构建了一个统一的动作导向型片段集合，并为其配备了标准化的文本描述，从而填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Recent surgical video generation methods have explored a wide range of architectures and conditioning strategies in pursuit of realistic surgical video synthesis. Endora [ 21 ] and Ophora [ 23 ] establish foundations of video generation in endoscopic and ophthalmic settings, respectively. SurgSora [ 5 ] leverages initial-frame, RGB-D, and flow cues to strengthen motion and semantic control, while HieraSurg [ 3 ] uses segmentation maps and hierarchical procedure annotations to impose phase and action structure. SAW [ 29 ] further combines language with reference scenes, affordance masks, and tool-tip trajectories for controllable surgical rollouts. Yet, most existing methods rely on auxiliary conditions for controllability, and acquiring such conditions at scale is often costly or impractical, fundamentally limiting scalability. Approaching the problem differently, FLAIR encodes optical-flow features as training-time supervision, enabling a reference-free, text-only inference architecture that generates realistic surgical videos without any auxiliary input during inference, offering a substantially more practical and scalable alternative to existing methods.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的手术视频生成方法探索了多种多样的架构和条件策略，以实现逼真的手术视频合成。 Endora [ 21 ] 和 Ophora [ 23 ] 分别在内窥镜和眼科场景下为视频生成奠定了基础。 SurgSora [ 5 ] 利用初始帧、RGB-D 数据和光流线索来增强运动与语义控制，而 HieraSurg [ 3 ] 则通过分割图和分层手术步骤标注来引入阶段与动作结构。 SAW [ 29 ] 进一步将语言信息与参考场景、可用性掩码和工具提示轨迹相结合，以实现可控的手术流程生成。 然而，大多数现有方法都依赖辅助条件来实现可控性，而大规模获取这些条件通常成本高昂或不切实际，从而从根本上限制了方法的可扩展性。 FLAIR 采用不同的问题处理方式，它将光流特征编码为训练时的监督信号，从而实现了一种无需参考输入、仅基于文本的推理架构，能够在推理阶段不依赖任何辅助输入的情况下生成逼真的手术视频，为现有方法提供了一种更具实用性和可扩展性的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Surgical video generation evaluation remains largely underexplored. Some existing surgical video benchmarks focus on downstream discriminative tasks, such as phase recognition, workflow analysis, and action recognition, where metrics including accuracy, F1 score, and Jaccard index are used to validate generation performance [ 35 , 27 , 41 ] . These metrics, however, are fundamentally unsuited for quantifying the quality of generated surgical videos. Therefore, current surgical video generation studies further adopt general-purpose video generation metrics, including FID, FVD, PSNR, Temporal IoU (TI), and Area Flicker (AF) [ 11 , 36 ] . While these metrics provide useful measures of overall visual similarity or semantic correspondence, they are insensitive to surgical-specific errors such as implausible instrument-tissue interactions, instrument deformation, or domain shift. Recent efforts such as SurgVeo introduce expert-based evaluation protocols for surgical video generation, highlighting the gap between visual plausibility and surgical correctness [ 6 ] . SurgMetrics addresses this gap by introducing a multi-axis, surgical scenario-specific evaluator, with six dedicated heads each quantifying a distinct dimension of surgical video quality. These per-axis scores together form a standardized, surgery-aware metric for evaluating generated surgical videos.
paragraphs.zh: 手术视频生成的评估领域在很大程度上仍处于探索不足的状态。 一些现有的手术视频基准数据集专注于下游的判别性任务，例如阶段识别、工作流程分析和动作识别，其中使用的指标包括准确率、F1分数和贾卡德指数，用于验证生成效果 [ 35 , 27 , 41 ] 。 然而，这些指标从根本上不适合量化所生成手术视频的质量。 因此，当前的手术视频生成研究进一步采用了通用视频生成指标，包括 FID、FVD、PSNR、时间 IoU（TI）和区域闪烁（AF）[ 11 , 36 ] 。 尽管这些指标为整体视觉相似性或语义对应性提供了有用的衡量标准，但它们对手术特有的错误（例如不合理的器械与组织相互作用、器械变形或领域偏移）并不敏感。 近期的研究，如 SurgVeo，引入了基于专家的手术视频生成评估协议，凸显了视觉合理性与实际手术正确性之间的差距 [ 6 ] 。 SurgMetrics 通过引入一种多轴且针对特定手术场景的评估器来解决这一差距，其中六个专用评估头分别量化手术视频质量的六个不同维度。 这些各轴的评分共同构成了一种标准化且具备手术感知能力的指标，用于评估生成的手术视频。

paragraphs.en: We assemble temporally compact surgical action clips from multiple domains into a unified corpus, SurgActionClip-30K , covering diverse anatomy, procedures, and actions. Guided by the cross-specialty action taxonomy of BSA-10 [ 44 ] , we carefully select 11 datasets, including CholecT50 [ 27 ] , AutoLaparo [ 41 ] , etc., to improve coverage of surgical actions and their procedural contexts. The resulting corpus includes laparoscopic, endoscopic, and microsurgical procedures, covering representative actions such as dissection, coagulation, clipping, retraction, and aspiration. All sources are converted into a unified clip-metadata-caption schema; source-level details are provided in Appendix B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从多个领域整合时间上紧凑的外科手术动作片段，构建了一个统一语料库 SurgActionClip-30K，涵盖了多样的解剖结构、手术程序和动作。 在 BSA-10 [44] 跨专科动作分类体系的指导下，我们精心挑选了 11 个数据集，包括 CholecT50 [27]、AutoLaparo [41] 等，以增强对手术动作及其程序性背景覆盖的完整性。 最终形成的语料库包含了腹腔镜、内窥镜和显微外科手术，涵盖了如解剖、凝血、夹闭、牵拉和吸引等代表性动作。 所有来源均被转换为统一的片段-元数据-描述格式；源数据层面的详细信息见附录 B.1。

paragraphs.en: We segment action-centric surgical clips from the original long videos using available phase, step, action, or temporal-interval annotations. Consecutive segments with consistent procedural labels are merged, while non-operative and uninformative segments are removed. For datasets without explicit instrument annotations, we employ a single-class YOLO detector [ 14 ] to estimate instrument presence and split clips when visible tool configurations change. Then, each resulting clip is paired with a structured caption following an instrument-action-target representation. We use Hulu-Med-4B [ 15 ] to generate initial descriptions, which are constrained by available annotations and verified for consistency with clip metadata. Beyond the core action triplet, we also enrich each caption with other detailed surgical annotations, including the procedure, anatomical context, tissue response, and imaging conditions to provide semantic supervision for learning surgical motion priors. Further details and examples of the filtering and captioning procedures are provided in Appendices B.2 and B.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用现有的阶段、步骤、动作或时间间隔标注，从原始长视频中分割出以动作为中心的 хирургические клипы。 具有一致手术流程标签的连续片段会被合并，而非手术性和无信息量的片段则会被移除。 对于没有明确器械标注的数据集，我们使用单类别 YOLO 检测器 [14] 来估计器械的存在情况，并在可见的器械配置发生变化时分割片段。 随后，每个生成的片段都会与一个遵循“器械-动作-目标”表示法的结构化描述相匹配。 我们使用 Hulu-Med-4B [15] 生成初始描述，这些描述受到可用标注的约束，并经过验证以确保与片段元数据的一致性。 除了核心的动作三元组外，我们还通过添加其他详细的手术标注来丰富每个描述，包括手术流程、解剖学背景、组织反应和成像条件，从而为学习手术动作先验提供语义监督。 关于筛选和描述生成流程的更多细节与示例，请参见附录 B.2 和 B.3。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 illustrates FLAIR. The Flow Action Encoder (FAE) first learns flow-derived latent action sequences Z Z from real surgical videos. The text-to-action predictor estimates the corresponding motion prior Z ^ \widehat{Z} from a prompt, while the action adapter injects global and temporal conditions into a frozen, domain-adapted diffusion transformer. At inference, the FAE is removed and generation requires only surgical prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了 FLAIR。 流动作编码器（FAE）首先从真实手术视频中学习由流推导出的潜在动作序列 Z Z。 文本到动作预测器根据提示词估计出对应的运动先验 Z ^ \widehat{Z}，而动作适配器则将全局和时序条件注入到一个经过领域自适应的冻结扩散变换器中。 在推理阶段，FAE 会被移除，生成过程仅需手术提示词。

paragraphs.en: The FAE is optimized using reconstruction and anti-collapse objectives:

paragraphs.en: The reconstruction loss ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{recon}} preserves the information required to recover the observed motion representation. The instance-discrimination objective ℒ inst \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{inst}} keeps distinct flow observations distinguishable in the latent space, while the variance-floor regularizer ℒ var \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{var}} prevents dimensional collapse without encouraging unbounded latent variation. Detailed formulations and optimization settings are provided in Appendices C.2 and E.2 .

paragraphs.en: Given a flow-derived latent action sequence Z ∈ ℝ K × d z Z\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times d_{z}} , we introduce a lightweight action adapter A ω A_{\omega} that converts the motion prior into global and temporally varying conditions for a frozen, domain-adapted diffusion Transformer. paragraphs.en: As no standardized surgical benchmark currently exists, we construct a 200-prompt benchmark based on the BSA-10 taxonomy [ 44 ] , covering ten basic surgical actions across eight procedures. The first 180 prompts form a balanced grid of six procedures, ten actions, and three phrasing variants, while the remaining 20 extend the evaluation to VATS lobectomy and hepatectomy for external generalization. Each prompt follows a structured instrument–action–target formulation, with fine-grained vocabulary grounded in available surgical annotations and manually extended to procedures not covered by those annotations. We use the same prompt set for all experimental comparisons; its construction and full distribution are detailed in Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 由于目前尚无标准化的手术基准，我们基于 BSA-10 分类法 [44] 构建了一个包含 200 条提示词的基准，涵盖了八种手术中的十项基本手术操作。 前 180 条提示词构成了一个平衡的网格，包括六种手术、十种操作和三种表述变体，而剩余的 20 条则将评估范围扩展至 VATS 肺叶切除术和肝切除术，以实现外部泛化能力。 每条提示词均遵循“器械–操作–目标”的结构化表述方式，其精细词汇基于现有手术标注，并通过人工扩展覆盖了这些标注未涵盖的手术。 我们在所有实验对比中均使用同一提示词集；其构建过程及完整分布详见附录 C.1。

paragraphs.en: Baselines and Comparisons. We evaluate FLAIR across three base models, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 38 ] , HunyuanVideo-1.5 [ 42 ] , and CogVideoX-2B [ 47 ] , against two baselines: a Base-model-only baseline and a LoRA baseline fully fine-tuned on our dataset until convergence, serving as weak and strong points of comparison, respectively. However, many existing surgical video generation methods do not release model checkpoints or generated outputs, which prevents our re-evaluation with SurgMetrics. We therefore further consider Cosmos-H-Surgical [ 10 ] and KVLR [ 20 ] , but omit FID/FVD for these methods because their reference-conditioned inference settings differ from our reference-free setting, and omit CLIP/SurgMetrics scores where raw generated videos are unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型与对比。 我们在三种基础模型——Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 38 ]、HunyuanVideo-1.5 [ 42 ] 和 CogVideoX-2B [ 47 ]——上评估了 FLAIR，并与两种基线模型进行了对比：一种仅使用基础模型的基线，以及一种在我们的数据集上完全微调直至收敛的 LoRA 基线，它们分别作为较弱的和较强的对比基准。 然而，许多现有的手术视频生成方法并未公开模型检查点或生成的输出，这使我们无法使用 SurgMetrics 进行重新评估。 因此，我们进一步考虑了 Cosmos-H-Surgical [ 10 ] 和 KVLR [ 20 ]，但由于这些方法的参考条件推理设置与我们的无参考设置不同，因此省略了它们的 FID/FVD 指标；此外，在无法获取原始生成视频的情况下，我们也省略了 CLIP/SurgMetrics 分数。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation of General Metrics. As shown in Table 1 , general-purpose metrics including VideoCLIP, TI and AF, show that FLAIR maintains competitive visual quality and correct execution specified by the prompt while introducing higher action consistency. However, these metrics evaluate mainly overall distribution similarity and temporal consistency, but cannot directly measure whether the generated motions are surgically plausible or ensure human alignment on surgical aspects.
paragraphs.zh: 通用指标评估。 如表 1 所示，包括 VideoCLIP、TI 和 AF 在内的通用指标表明，FLAIR 在保持具有竞争力的视觉质量和提示所指定的正确执行的同时，还实现了更高的动作一致性。 然而，这些指标主要评估整体分布相似性和时间一致性，但无法直接衡量生成的动作是否具有手术上的合理性，也无法确保在手术相关方面与人类操作保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation on SurgMetrics. We further evaluate the generated videos with SurgMetrics, which provides surgical-specific diagnosis through artifact axes. Compared with conventional domain fine-tuned baselines, FLAIR achieves lower artifact evidence across the majority of axes, particularly in motion-related factors such as Drift, Instrument Deformation, and Tracklet Instability. This indicates that learning action-level motion priors from optical-flow-derived representations improves procedural motion consistency beyond appearance-level adaptation. FLAIR demonstrates better execution of instrument–action–target interaction specified by the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SurgMetrics 上的评估。 我们进一步使用 SurgMetrics 对生成的视频进行评估，该工具通过伪影轴提供手术特定的诊断。 与传统的领域微调基线模型相比，FLAIR 在大多数轴上均表现出更低的伪影证据，尤其是在与运动相关的因素（如漂移、器械变形和轨迹不稳定）方面。 这表明，从光流衍生表示中学习动作层面的运动先验，能够超越外观层面的适应，从而提升手术流程的运动一致性。 FLAIR 在按照提示执行器械–动作–目标交互方面表现更优。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results: Human Perception. Figure 3 compares Wan2.1 LoRA and Wan2.1 LoRA-FLAIR under identical generation settings across frames t ∈ [ 0 − 81 ] t\in[0-81] . LoRA-only exhibits inconsistent instrument motion that escalates into structural artifacts, including a spurious second instrument and a persistent geometric fusion between instrument and tissue in later frames. In contrast, Wan2.1 LoRA-FLAIR remains stable throughout, producing a more coherent motion trajectory and sustained instrument–tissue interaction that closely aligns with real surgical dynamics. Additional qualitative results are provided in Appendix C.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 定性结果：人类感知。 图3在完全相同的生成设置下，对比了 Wan2.1 LoRA 和 Wan2.1 LoRA-FLAIR 在 t ∈ [0−81] 各帧中的表现。 仅使用 LoRA 的版本表现出器械运动不一致的问题，这一问题逐渐演变为结构异常，包括出现一个虚假的第二器械，以及在后续帧中器械与组织之间持续存在的几何融合。 相比之下，Wan2.1 LoRA-FLAIR 在整个过程中保持稳定，生成了更连贯的运动轨迹，并维持了器械与组织之间的相互作用，这与真实手术动态高度一致。 更多定性结果见附录 C.4。

paragraphs.en: We conducted a human evaluation of 90 generated laparoscopic videos, with ten videos from each of nine model configurations. Four specialist surgeons with approximately 7–21 years of clinical experience independently rated each video on a five-point ordinal scale. Videos were anonymized and randomly shuffled, with only the corresponding prompts shown. Evaluators assessed visible defects corresponding to the six SurgMetrics dimensions, as well as overall video quality and the correctness of the “instrument–action–target“ interaction specified by the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对90段生成的腹腔镜视频进行了人类评估，其中每个模型配置提供了10段视频。 四名拥有约7至21年临床经验的专科外科医生独立地用五点序数量表对每段视频进行评分。 视频经过匿名处理和随机打乱，仅显示对应的提示语。 评估者检查了与SurgMetrics六个维度相对应的可见缺陷，以及视频的整体质量和提示语所指定的“器械–动作–目标”交互的正确性。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether SurgMetrics captures native generation failures beyond its synthetic training degradations, we compared each axis with the corresponding human rating. Spearman correlations ranged from 0.746 to 0.867, indicating strong agreement with human judgments. Inter-rater reliability was also high, with ICC(2,4) values of 0.721–0.832 across artifact axes and 0.742–0.825 for action correctness [ 17 ] . After adjusting for model identity, the correlation with overall human-rated quality remained strong, decreasing from 0.845 to 0.731, indicating that the association was not solely driven by differences among models. FLAIR also received lower interaction-error ratings than the LoRA baseline across all three backbones, with paired confidence intervals excluding zero. Overall, these results show strong human alignment of SurgMetrics and consistent improvements in action correctness with FLAIR. The current validation is restricted to laparoscopic videos; full validation details are provided in Appendix D.2.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 SurgMetrics 是否捕捉到了其合成训练退化之外的原生生成失败，我们将每个轴与相应的人类评分进行了比较。 Spearman 相关系数在 0.746 到 0.867 之间，表明与人类判断高度一致。 评分者间可靠性也很高，各人工制品轴的 ICC(2,4) 值为 0.721–0.832，动作正确性的 ICC(2,4) 值为 0.742–0.825 [ 17 ]。 在调整模型身份后，与人类总体质量评分的相关性仍然很强，从 0.845 降至 0.731，表明这种关联并非完全由模型间的差异所驱动。 在所有三种骨干网络中，FLAIR 的交互错误评分也低于 LoRA 基线，且配对置信区间均不包含零。 总体而言，这些结果表明 SurgMetrics 与人类判断高度一致，并且 FLAIR 在动作正确性方面实现了持续改进。 当前的验证仅限于腹腔镜视频；完整的验证细节见附录 D.2.1。

paragraphs.en: We introduce FLAIR, a reference-free framework that encodes motion priors from optical flow into a latent action space, dynamically injecting them into a frozen video diffusion model to generate surgical videos with improved motion stability and action consistency without auxiliary conditions at inference time. To support this direction, we further contribute SurgActionClip-30K and SurgMetrics, together establishing an integrated foundation spanning modeling, data, and evaluation for scalable, action-aware surgical video generation. We hope these resources catalyze future research at the intersection of generative modeling and surgical video understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FLAIR，一个无需参考的框架，它将光流中的运动先验编码到潜在动作空间中，并在推理时动态地将这些先验注入冻结的视频扩散模型中，从而生成具有更高运动稳定性和动作一致性的手术视频，且无需辅助条件。 为了支持这一方向，我们进一步贡献了 SurgActionClip-30K 和 SurgMetrics，共同构建了一个涵盖建模、数据和评估的集成基础，为可扩展且具备动作感知能力的手术视频生成提供了支撑。 我们希望这些资源能够推动生成模型与手术视频理解交叉领域中的未来研究。

sents.en: We introduce FLAIR, a reference-free framework that encodes motion priors from optical flow into a latent action space, dynamically injecting them into a frozen video diffusion model to generate surgical videos with improved motion stability and action consistency without auxiliary conditions at inference time.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 FLAIR，一个无需参考的框架，它将光流中的运动先验编码到潜在动作空间中，并在推理时动态地将这些先验注入冻结的视频扩散模型中，从而生成具有更高运动稳定性和动作一致性的手术视频，且无需辅助条件。

sents.en: To support this direction, we further contribute SurgActionClip-30K and SurgMetrics, together establishing an integrated foundation spanning modeling, data, and evaluation for scalable, action-aware surgical video generation.
sents.zh: 为了支持这一方向，我们进一步贡献了 SurgActionClip-30K 和 SurgMetrics，共同构建了一个涵盖建模、数据和评估的集成基础，为可扩展且具备动作感知能力的手术视频生成提供了支撑。

sents.en: We hope these resources catalyze future research at the intersection of generative modeling and surgical video understanding.
sents.zh: 我们希望这些资源能够推动生成模型与手术视频理解交叉领域中的未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Generative AI tools were used in two parts of this work. First, Hulu-Med-4B was used during dataset construction to generate initial structured captions for surgical video clips, conditioned on available procedural and annotation metadata. These captions were subsequently constrained and checked for consistency with the corresponding clip metadata, as described in the paper. Second, a large language model was used to assist with language editing and improving the clarity of the manuscript. All methodological design, experiments, data processing, analysis, interpretation of results, and scientific conclusions were carried out and verified by the authors.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能工具被用于本研究的两个部分。 首先，在数据集构建过程中，Hulu-Med-4B 被用来根据可用的手术流程信息和标注元数据，为手术视频片段生成初步的结构化描述。 随后，这些描述受到约束，并依据论文中的方法对其与对应片段元数据的一致性进行了检查。 其次，一个大语言模型被用于协助语言编辑，并提升手稿的清晰度。 所有的方法设计、实验、数据处理、分析、结果解读以及科学结论均由作者执行和验证。

paragraphs.en: This work uses anonymized surgical video data obtained from publicly available research datasets, and the authors had no access to personally identifiable patient information. SurgActionClip-30K is planned for public release, including metadata and processed video clips where redistribution is permitted by the corresponding source licenses. The human-alignment study involved four surgeons with specialist qualifications and 7–21 years of clinical experience; all participated with informed consent and received no financial compensation. Hulu-Med-4B was run locally for caption generation, and no surgical video data were transmitted to external services. FLAIR-generated videos are intended solely for research and education and should not be used for clinical decision-making, diagnosis, treatment planning, or intraoperative guidance.

paragraphs.en: This section of the appendix provides more discussion on the main design choices underlying FLAIR and SurgMetrics.

paragraphs.en: Surgical video differs from general-domain video along two fundamental axes: semantic granularity and visual dynamics [ 25 ] . These differences explain why many architectures and training strategies that succeed in general-domain video generation do not transfer directly to the surgical setting.
paragraphs.zh: 手术视频与通用领域视频在两个基本维度上存在差异：语义颗粒度和视觉动态性 [ 25 ] 。 这些差异解释了为何许多在通用领域视频生成中表现出色的架构和训练策略无法直接迁移到手术场景。

sents.en: Surgical video differs from general-domain video along two fundamental axes: semantic granularity and visual dynamics [ 25 ] .
sents.zh: 手术视频与通用领域视频在两个基本维度上存在差异：语义颗粒度和视觉动态性 [ 25 ] 。

sents.en: These differences explain why many architectures and training strategies that succeed in general-domain video generation do not transfer directly to the surgical setting.
sents.zh: 这些差异解释了为何许多在通用领域视频生成中表现出色的架构和训练策略无法直接迁移到手术场景。

paragraphs.en: In general-domain video, an action is typically recognizable at a coarse level: whether a person is walking, jumping, or waving conveys the intended semantics even under substantial variation in speed, trajectory, or viewpoint [ 31 , 40 , 4 ] . Surgical actions do not enjoy this tolerance. A small deviation in instrument angle, contact depth, or approach trajectory can change the clinical meaning of a motion entirely, e.g., the difference between grasping and gripping too forcefully, or between coagulation and inadvertent tissue damage, is often a matter of a few pixels of instrument-tissue overlap rather than a qualitatively different motion pattern [ 27 ] . This means that surgical video generation must be evaluated and supervised at a substantially finer level of motion granularity than general-domain video, where coarse trajectory-level similarity is often sufficient. Architectures designed to capture broad, semantically distinct motion categories in general-domain video are therefore not naturally suited to distinguishing these fine-grained, clinically meaningful variations, motivating our use of optical flow, rather than coarse action labels or trajectory sketches, as a supervisory signal for learning surgical motion priors.
paragraphs.zh: 在通用领域的视频中，动作通常可以在粗略层面上被识别：一个人是在行走、跳跃还是挥手，即使速度、轨迹或视角存在显著差异，也能传达出预期的语义 [ 31 , 40 , 4 ] 。 外科手术动作并不具备这种容错性。 器械角度、接触深度或接近轨迹的微小偏差都可能完全改变某个动作的临床意义，例如，抓握与过度用力紧握之间的区别，或凝血与意外组织损伤之间的区别，往往仅取决于器械与组织重叠的几个像素，而非质上不同的运动模式 [ 27 ] 。 这意味着，外科手术视频的生成必须在比通用领域视频精细得多的运动粒度层面上进行评估和监督；而在通用领域视频中，粗略的轨迹级相似性通常就足够了。 因此，为在通用领域视频中捕捉广泛且语义明确的动作类别而设计的架构，并不天然适合区分这些细微且具有临床意义的变化，这促使我们采用光流而非粗略的动作标签或轨迹草图作为监督信号，以学习外科手术动作的先验知识。

paragraphs.en: General-domain videos are also naturally characterized by large motion magnitudes and substantial scene change: subjects move across the frame, cameras pan or cut, and backgrounds shift as the scene evolves. Surgical videos exhibit the opposite tendency. In a typical laparoscopic or endoscopic clip, the majority of the visual field, the surrounding anatomy, the camera framing, and the overall scene layout, remains largely static, with only the instrument and the immediately interacting tissue undergoing subtle, localized motion. This asymmetry between a mostly static background and a small, semantically critical region of motion is precisely what motivates our use of optical flow as the supervisory signal in FLAIR: optical flow naturally suppresses the dominant, uninformative static background and isolates exactly the small-magnitude, instrument-tissue motion that carries surgical meaning [ 26 , 33 ] , whereas RGB-based or trajectory-sketch-based conditioning, which are more effective when scene-level motion is itself informative, provide comparatively little additional signal in a domain where the background barely changes.
paragraphs.zh: 通用领域的视频也天然具有较大的运动幅度和显著的场景变化：主体在画面中移动，摄像头进行平移或切换，背景也会随着场景的演变而改变。 手术视频则呈现出相反的趋势。 在一典型的腹腔镜或内窥镜片段中，大部分视觉区域、周围解剖结构、摄像头构图以及整体场景布局基本保持静态，只有器械和直接与之交互的组织会发生细微的局部运动。 这种以静态背景为主、仅存在一个语义关键的小范围运动区域的不对称性，正是我们采用光流作为 FLAIR 的监督信号的原因：光流能够自然地抑制主导画面且缺乏信息量的静态背景，精准地分离出具有手术意义的微小幅度的器械-组织运动 [26, 33]；而基于 RGB 或轨迹草图的条件约束，在场景级运动本身具有信息量时更为有效，但在背景几乎不发生变化的领域内，所能提供的额外信号则相对有限。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these two properties, high semantic sensitivity to small motion deviations and a naturally low-motion, background-static visual regime, distinguish surgical video from the general-domain videos that most existing video generation architectures and conditioning strategies are designed around [ 12 , 24 , 18 ] , and directly motivate FLAIR’s core design choice of encoding motion priors from optical flow.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这两个特性——对微小运动偏差的高度语义敏感性，以及天然的低运动、背景静态的视觉环境——使手术视频区别于大多数现有视频生成架构和条件策略所针对的一般领域视频 [ 12 , 24 , 18 ] ，并直接促成了 FLAIR 的核心设计选择：从光流中编码运动先验。

paragraphs.en: Building on this domain-level distinction, the effectiveness of FLAIR is further grounded in an observation about the structure of surgical motion itself. Relative to the broad motion space of general-domain videos, surgical videos occupy a substantially narrower region constrained by anatomy, instrument affordances, and procedural workflow: instruments can only move in ways that are mechanically feasible within the surgical field, and their trajectories are further shaped by the anatomical target and the stage of the procedure. Within this already-narrow domain, instances of a specific action concentrate further into a compact, action-conditioned region, since surgeons executing the same basic action (e.g., clipping, dissection, retraction) tend to follow similar approach angles, instrument-tissue contact patterns, and motion durations across patients and procedures. This structure means that, unlike general-domain text-to-video generation, where a prompt must implicitly resolve an enormous space of plausible motions, a surgical prompt only needs to identify the intended action and route it into this compact region; the canonical execution pattern within that region can then be learned directly from recurring examples in real surgical videos. FLAIR is designed to exploit exactly this property: the flow action encoder distills the compact, action-conditioned motion patterns present in real surgical clips into a latent space, and the text-to-action predictor learns to map a surgical prompt into this same compact region rather than predicting arbitrary frame-level dynamics from scratch. This explains why injecting a flow-derived latent action prior, rather than relying on the base diffusion model’s general-purpose motion prior, yields more stable and action-consistent surgical motion at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这种领域层面的区分，FLAIR 的有效性还进一步建立在对手术动作本身结构的观察之上。 与通用领域视频中宽泛的动作空间相比，手术视频占据了一个明显更狭窄的区域，该区域受到解剖结构、器械特性以及操作流程的约束：器械只能在手术区域内以机械上可行的方式移动，其运动轨迹还会受到解剖学目标及手术阶段的影响。 在这个本就狭窄的领域中，特定动作的实例会进一步集中在一个紧凑且由动作决定的区域内，因为执行相同基本动作（例如夹闭、分离或牵拉）的外科医生，在不同患者和手术中往往遵循相似的操作角度、器械与组织的接触模式以及动作持续时间。 这种结构意味着，与通用领域的文本到视频生成不同——在后者中，提示必须隐式地解决一个包含大量可能动作的巨大空间——手术提示只需识别预期的动作，并将其引导至这个紧凑区域；随后，该区域内的典型执行模式可以直接从真实手术视频中反复出现的示例中学习。 FLAIR 的设计正是为了利用这一特性：流动作编码器将真实手术片段中存在的紧凑且由动作决定的运动模式提炼为潜在空间，而文本到动作预测器则学习将手术提示映射至这个相同的紧凑区域，而不是从头开始预测任意的帧级动态。 这解释了为何在推理阶段，注入基于流推导出的潜在动作先验，而非依赖基础扩散模型的一般性动作先验，能够产生更稳定且与动作一致的手术运动。

paragraphs.en: SurgMetrics is motivated by a complementary observation about the nature of failure modes in generated surgical video. Unlike open-ended, general-domain video generation, where failure modes can be highly diverse and difficult to anticipate, the ways in which current surgical video generation models fail are comparatively enumerable: instruments intermittently disappearing or reappearing, geometric drift and structural instability across frames, implausible instrument or tissue deformation, and physically inconsistent instrument-tissue interaction recur across models and backbones [ 7 , 21 , 48 , 5 , 6 ] , as also observed qualitatively in our comparisons (Appendix C.4 ). This enumerability suggests that, rather than requiring costly expert annotation of every generated sample, a substantial fraction of surgical-domain failure modes can instead be synthesized by deliberately applying controlled degradations to clean, real laparoscopic clips. SurgMetrics is built on this premise: by constructing 21 degradation families that emulate these recurring artifact types and training a multi-axis evaluator to detect them, we obtain a scalable and reproducible surrogate for surgical-domain video quality assessment, without depending on general-purpose metrics [ 11 , 37 , 13 ] that are insensitive to surgical-specific errors or on expert review for every comparison. Our human-alignment validation (Appendix D.2.1 ) further supports the practical value of this approach, showing that scores derived from these synthesized artifacts correlate strongly with human judgments of real generated surgical videos.
paragraphs.zh: SurgMetrics 的灵感源于对生成手术视频中故障模式本质的一项补充性观察。 与开放式的通用领域视频生成不同——后者中的故障模式可能高度多样化且难以预测——当前手术视频生成模型出现故障的方式相对有限且可枚举：器械间歇性消失或重现、帧间几何漂移和结构不稳定、不合理的器械或组织形变，以及物理上不一致的器械-组织相互作用，这些现象在不同模型和基础架构中反复出现 [ 7 , 21 , 48 , 5 , 6 ]，正如我们在定性比较（附录 C.4）中也观察到的那样。 这种可枚举性表明，与其要求对每个生成样本进行昂贵的人工专家标注，不如通过故意对干净的真实腹腔镜片段施加受控的退化处理，来合成手术领域故障模式的很大一部分。 SurgMetrics 正是基于这一前提构建的：通过构建 21 个模拟这些重复出现的人工缺陷类型的退化家族，并训练一个多轴评估器来检测它们，我们获得了一种可扩展且可复现的手术领域视频质量评估替代方案，无需依赖对手术特定错误不敏感的通用指标 [ 11 , 37 , 13 ]，也无需每次比较都依赖专家审查。 我们进行的人类对齐验证（附录 D.2.1）进一步支持了这一方法的实际价值，结果表明，由这些合成人工缺陷得出的分数与人类对真实生成手术视频的判断高度相关。

paragraphs.en: This section provides additional details on the source selection, temporal segmentation, instrument-aware refinement, caption generation, and quality control used to construct SurgActionClip-30K. The overall pipeline is shown in Figure 4 , which aims to convert heterogeneous, procedure-level surgical videos into a common set of temporally compact clips, each describing a localized surgical activity and paired with action-aware textual supervision. We use the finest temporal annotation available in each source rather than assuming that all datasets provide action labels at the same granularity.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提供了有关构建 SurgActionClip-30K 所采用的源数据选择、时间分割、仪器感知优化、标题生成和质量控制等方面的更多细节。 整体流程如图 4 所示，其目标是将异构的、以手术程序为单位的手术视频转换为一组共同的时间紧凑片段，每个片段描述一项局部化的手术活动，并配有具备动作感知的文本监督信息。 我们使用每个源数据中可用的最精细时间标注，而不是假设所有数据集都以相同的粒度提供动作标签。

sents.en: This section provides additional details on the source selection, temporal segmentation, instrument-aware refinement, caption generation, and quality control used to construct SurgActionClip-30K.
sents.zh: 本节提供了有关构建 SurgActionClip-30K 所采用的源数据选择、时间分割、仪器感知优化、标题生成和质量控制等方面的更多细节。

sents.en: The overall pipeline is shown in Figure 4 , which aims to convert heterogeneous, procedure-level surgical videos into a common set of temporally compact clips, each describing a localized surgical activity and paired with action-aware textual supervision.
sents.zh: 整体流程如图 4 所示，其目标是将异构的、以手术程序为单位的手术视频转换为一组共同的时间紧凑片段，每个片段描述一项局部化的手术活动，并配有具备动作感知的文本监督信息。

sents.en: We use the finest temporal annotation available in each source rather than assuming that all datasets provide action labels at the same granularity.
sents.zh: 我们使用每个源数据中可用的最精细时间标注，而不是假设所有数据集都以相同的粒度提供动作标签。

paragraphs.en: The source datasets span laparoscopic, robotic, rigid-endoscopic, and ophthalmic procedures. Their native annotations range from coarse surgical phases to fine-grained steps, action classes, instrument identities, and explicit temporal intervals. This diversity broadens the coverage of anatomy, procedural context, instrument appearance, and instrument–tissue interaction in the resulting corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 源数据集涵盖了腹腔镜、机器人手术、硬性内窥镜和眼科手术等操作。 其原始标注范围从粗略的手术阶段到精细的步骤、动作类别、器械识别以及明确的时间区间不等。 这种多样性扩大了最终语料库中解剖结构、操作背景、器械外观以及器械与组织相互作用的范围。

sents.en: The source datasets span laparoscopic, robotic, rigid-endoscopic, and ophthalmic procedures.
sents.zh: 源数据集涵盖了腹腔镜、机器人手术、硬性内窥镜和眼科手术等操作。

sents.en: Their native annotations range from coarse surgical phases to fine-grained steps, action classes, instrument identities, and explicit temporal intervals.
sents.zh: 其原始标注范围从粗略的手术阶段到精细的步骤、动作类别、器械识别以及明确的时间区间不等。

sents.en: This diversity broadens the coverage of anatomy, procedural context, instrument appearance, and instrument–tissue interaction in the resulting corpus.
sents.zh: 这种多样性扩大了最终语料库中解剖结构、操作背景、器械外观以及器械与组织相互作用的范围。

paragraphs.en: Irrespective of the source format, every retained sample is converted to a common representation containing a unique clip identifier, its source case or video, the available procedural label, instrument information when available, the clip path, and a structured caption. Source-specific labels are preserved in the metadata instead of being forcibly mapped to a single closed vocabulary. This avoids conflating differently defined phases or actions while allowing a shared data loader to consume all sources.
paragraphs.zh: 无论源格式如何，每个保留的样本都会被转换为一种通用表示形式，其中包含唯一的片段标识符、其来源案例或视频、可用的程序性标签、可用时的仪器信息、片段路径以及结构化说明。 特定于来源的标签会保留在元数据中，而不是被强制映射到单一的封闭词汇表。 这避免了将定义不同的阶段或动作混为一谈，同时允许共享的数据加载器处理所有来源。

sents.en: Irrespective of the source format, every retained sample is converted to a common representation containing a unique clip identifier, its source case or video, the available procedural label, instrument information when available, the clip path, and a structured caption.
sents.zh: 无论源格式如何，每个保留的样本都会被转换为一种通用表示形式，其中包含唯一的片段标识符、其来源案例或视频、可用的程序性标签、可用时的仪器信息、片段路径以及结构化说明。

sents.en: Source-specific labels are preserved in the metadata instead of being forcibly mapped to a single closed vocabulary.
sents.zh: 特定于来源的标签会保留在元数据中，而不是被强制映射到单一的封闭词汇表。

sents.en: This avoids conflating differently defined phases or actions while allowing a shared data loader to consume all sources.
sents.zh: 这避免了将定义不同的阶段或动作混为一谈，同时允许共享的数据加载器处理所有来源。

paragraphs.en: For datasets with frame-level or second-level phase, step, or action labels, we first run-length encode consecutive identical labels. Each maximal run becomes a candidate temporal interval. Datasets that already provide localized intervals, such as OphNet, use the annotated start and end times directly. For SLAM, consecutive short parts sharing the same patient, video, camera, and action identifiers are concatenated, while the annotated looping tail is removed before concatenation. CholecT50, SurgicalActions160, and SurgVU24 retain their native action-triplet, action-class, or clip boundaries, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 对于具有帧级或秒级阶段、步骤或动作标签的数据集，我们首先对连续相同的标签进行运行长度编码。 每个最大连续段都成为一个候选时间区间。 对于已经提供局部化区间的数据集（例如 OphNet），可以直接使用标注的起始和结束时间。 对于 SLAM，共享相同患者、视频、摄像头和动作标识符的连续短部分会被拼接在一起，但在拼接之前会移除标注的循环尾部。 CholecT50、SurgicalActions160 和 SurgVU24 分别保留其原始的动作三元组、动作类别或剪辑边界。

sents.en: For datasets with frame-level or second-level phase, step, or action labels, we first run-length encode consecutive identical labels.
sents.zh: 对于具有帧级或秒级阶段、步骤或动作标签的数据集，我们首先对连续相同的标签进行运行长度编码。

sents.en: Each maximal run becomes a candidate temporal interval.
sents.zh: 每个最大连续段都成为一个候选时间区间。

sents.en: Datasets that already provide localized intervals, such as OphNet, use the annotated start and end times directly.
sents.zh: 对于已经提供局部化区间的数据集（例如 OphNet），可以直接使用标注的起始和结束时间。

sents.en: For SLAM, consecutive short parts sharing the same patient, video, camera, and action identifiers are concatenated, while the annotated looping tail is removed before concatenation.
sents.zh: 对于 SLAM，共享相同患者、视频、摄像头和动作标识符的连续短部分会被拼接在一起，但在拼接之前会移除标注的循环尾部。

sents.en: CholecT50, SurgicalActions160, and SurgVU24 retain their native action-triplet, action-class, or clip boundaries, respectively.
sents.zh: CholecT50、SurgicalActions160 和 SurgVU24 分别保留其原始的动作三元组、动作类别或剪辑边界。

paragraphs.en: When instrument annotations are available, they are preferred to automatically inferred labels. PhaKIR intervals are defined by stable ( phase , instrument set ) (\text{phase},\text{instrument set}) pairs, and PitVis intervals are defined by stable ( step , instrument set ) (\text{step},\text{instrument set}) pairs. Consequently, a clip does not silently cross an annotated instrument change.
paragraphs.zh: 当仪器标注可用时，应优先使用这些标注，而非自动推断的标签。 PhaKIR 区间由稳定的（相位，仪器集）(\text{phase},\text{instrument set}) 对定义，而 PitVis 区间则由稳定的（步长，仪器集）(\text{step},\text{instrument set}) 对定义。 因此，一个剪辑片段不会悄无声息地跨越已标注的仪器变更。

sents.en: When instrument annotations are available, they are preferred to automatically inferred labels.
sents.zh: 当仪器标注可用时，应优先使用这些标注，而非自动推断的标签。

sents.en: PhaKIR intervals are defined by stable ( phase , instrument set ) (\text{phase},\text{instrument set}) pairs, and PitVis intervals are defined by stable ( step , instrument set ) (\text{step},\text{instrument set}) pairs.
sents.zh: PhaKIR 区间由稳定的（相位，仪器集）(\text{phase},\text{instrument set}) 对定义，而 PitVis 区间则由稳定的（步长，仪器集）(\text{step},\text{instrument set}) 对定义。

sents.en: Consequently, a clip does not silently cross an annotated instrument change.
sents.zh: 因此，一个剪辑片段不会悄无声息地跨越已标注的仪器变更。

paragraphs.en: For laparoscopic sources without instrument annotations, we apply a single-class YOLO detector [ 14 ] as a tool-presence model. The detector is evaluated at 5 frames per second with a confidence threshold of 0.25. Short detection gaps of at most 0.5 seconds are bridged to tolerate temporary occlusion and isolated false negatives. Longer tool-absent intervals create new boundaries, and sub-clips without a usable tool-present run are discarded. This refinement is restricted to visually compatible laparoscopic sources. It is not applied to ophthalmic microscopy or fisheye gastrointestinal endoscopy, where the domain gap would make detector-derived supervision unreliable.
paragraphs.zh: 对于没有器械标注的腹腔镜源，我们使用单类别 YOLO 检测器 [14] 作为器械存在模型。 该检测器以每秒 5 帧的速度进行评估，置信度阈值为 0.25。 最长不超过 0.5 秒的短暂检测间隙会被填补，以容忍暂时性遮挡和孤立的假阴性结果。 更长的器械缺失区间会形成新的边界，而没有可用器械存在段的子片段则会被丢弃。 这种优化仅适用于在视觉上兼容的腹腔镜源。 它不适用于眼科显微镜或鱼眼胃肠道内窥镜，因为域差异会使基于检测器的监督变得不可靠。

sents.en: For laparoscopic sources without instrument annotations, we apply a single-class YOLO detector [ 14 ] as a tool-presence model.
sents.zh: 对于没有器械标注的腹腔镜源，我们使用单类别 YOLO 检测器 [14] 作为器械存在模型。

sents.en: The detector is evaluated at 5 frames per second with a confidence threshold of 0.25.
sents.zh: 该检测器以每秒 5 帧的速度进行评估，置信度阈值为 0.25。

sents.en: Short detection gaps of at most 0.5 seconds are bridged to tolerate temporary occlusion and isolated false negatives.
sents.zh: 最长不超过 0.5 秒的短暂检测间隙会被填补，以容忍暂时性遮挡和孤立的假阴性结果。

sents.en: Longer tool-absent intervals create new boundaries, and sub-clips without a usable tool-present run are discarded.
sents.zh: 更长的器械缺失区间会形成新的边界，而没有可用器械存在段的子片段则会被丢弃。

sents.en: This refinement is restricted to visually compatible laparoscopic sources.
sents.zh: 这种优化仅适用于在视觉上兼容的腹腔镜源。

sents.en: It is not applied to ophthalmic microscopy or fisheye gastrointestinal endoscopy, where the domain gap would make detector-derived supervision unreliable.
sents.zh: 它不适用于眼科显微镜或鱼眼胃肠道内窥镜，因为域差异会使基于检测器的监督变得不可靠。

paragraphs.en: Except for short native action units in SLAM, candidate clips shorter than 3 seconds are removed. Long intervals are divided into non-overlapping pieces of at most 30 seconds without crossing the original annotation boundary. We also remove explicitly non-operative or uninformative labels. For example, the “Others” phase is excluded from ESD57, “Undefined” intervals are excluded from PhaKIR, and “Non-functional,” “Step Interval,” and “Invalid Segment” intervals are excluded from OphNet. Audio is removed when clips are written. These operations yield temporally compact samples while retaining the procedural label inherited from the source interval.
paragraphs.zh: 除了 SLAM 中的短原生动作单元外，时长少于 3 秒的候选片段都会被移除。 长区间会被划分为最多 30 秒且不重叠的片段，同时不会跨越原始标注边界。 我们还会移除明确非操作性的或无信息价值的标签。 例如，“Others”阶段会从 ESD57 中排除，“Undefined”区间会从 PhaKIR 中排除，而“Non-functional”、“Step Interval”和“Invalid Segment”区间则会从 OphNet 中排除。 在写入片段时，音频会被移除。 这些操作能够生成时间上更紧凑的样本，同时保留从源区间继承而来的流程标签。

sents.en: Except for short native action units in SLAM, candidate clips shorter than 3 seconds are removed.
sents.zh: 除了 SLAM 中的短原生动作单元外，时长少于 3 秒的候选片段都会被移除。

sents.en: Long intervals are divided into non-overlapping pieces of at most 30 seconds without crossing the original annotation boundary.
sents.zh: 长区间会被划分为最多 30 秒且不重叠的片段，同时不会跨越原始标注边界。

sents.en: We also remove explicitly non-operative or uninformative labels.
sents.zh: 我们还会移除明确非操作性的或无信息价值的标签。

sents.en: For example, the “Others” phase is excluded from ESD57, “Undefined” intervals are excluded from PhaKIR, and “Non-functional,” “Step Interval,” and “Invalid Segment” intervals are excluded from OphNet.
sents.zh: 例如，“Others”阶段会从 ESD57 中排除，“Undefined”区间会从 PhaKIR 中排除，而“Non-functional”、“Step Interval”和“Invalid Segment”区间则会从 OphNet 中排除。

sents.en: Audio is removed when clips are written.
sents.zh: 在写入片段时，音频会被移除。

sents.en: These operations yield temporally compact samples while retaining the procedural label inherited from the source interval.
sents.zh: 这些操作能够生成时间上更紧凑的样本，同时保留从源区间继承而来的流程标签。

paragraphs.en: Each extracted clip is captioned with Hulu-Med-4B [ 15 ] using a shared prompt template. The prompt supplies the available procedure, phase, step, action, and instrument metadata and asks the model to describe six semantic components: (1) procedural context, (2) visible instruments, (3) instrument action, (4) anatomical target and surrounding structures, (5) tissue appearance and response, and (6) lighting and camera perspective. The central semantic unit is an instrument–action–target description, while the remaining components provide contextual supervision useful for surgical video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 每个提取出的片段都使用共享提示模板，通过 Hulu-Med-4B [ 15 ] 添加标题。 该提示提供了可用程序、阶段、步骤、动作和器械的元数据，并要求模型描述六个语义组成部分：(1) 程序背景，(2) 可见器械，(3) 器械动作，(4) 解剖学目标及周围结构，(5) 组织外观与反应，以及 (6) 光照与摄像头视角。 核心语义单元是“器械–动作–目标”描述，其余组成部分则提供有助于手术视频生成的背景监督信息。

sents.en: Each extracted clip is captioned with Hulu-Med-4B [ 15 ] using a shared prompt template.
sents.zh: 每个提取出的片段都使用共享提示模板，通过 Hulu-Med-4B [ 15 ] 添加标题。

sents.en: The prompt supplies the available procedure, phase, step, action, and instrument metadata and asks the model to describe six semantic components: (1) procedural context, (2) visible instruments, (3) instrument action, (4) anatomical target and surrounding structures, (5) tissue appearance and response, and (6) lighting and camera perspective.
sents.zh: 该提示提供了可用程序、阶段、步骤、动作和器械的元数据，并要求模型描述六个语义组成部分：(1) 程序背景，(2) 可见器械，(3) 器械动作，(4) 解剖学目标及周围结构，(5) 组织外观与反应，以及 (6) 光照与摄像头视角。

sents.en: The central semantic unit is an instrument–action–target description, while the remaining components provide contextual supervision useful for surgical video generation.
sents.zh: 核心语义单元是“器械–动作–目标”描述，其余组成部分则提供有助于手术视频生成的背景监督信息。

paragraphs.en: The instrument clause depends on the available supervision. If a source provides instrument identities, the prompt lists them as an exhaustive set and forbids additional instruments. If only detector-derived instrument counts are available, the prompt constrains the number of instruments mentioned but lets the model identify their types from the video. If neither identity nor a reliable count is available, the model uses open-vocabulary descriptions and is instructed to mention only instruments that are visible. Domain-appropriate instrument examples are supplied as guidance rather than as a closed label set. This tiered design reduces unsupported tool hallucination without treating cross-domain detector predictions as ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 仪器条款取决于可用的监督情况。 如果某个来源提供了仪器的身份标识，提示会将它们列为完整集合，并禁止添加其他仪器。 如果仅能获取由探测器推导出的仪器数量，提示会限制提及的仪器数量，但允许模型从视频中识别其类型。 如果既没有身份标识也没有可靠的数量信息，模型将使用开放词汇描述，并被指示仅提及可见的仪器。 领域相关的仪器示例被用作指导，而非封闭的标签集合。 这种分层设计减少了无法支持的工具幻觉，同时不会将跨领域的探测器预测视为基准事实。

sents.en: The instrument clause depends on the available supervision.
sents.zh: 仪器条款取决于可用的监督情况。

sents.en: If a source provides instrument identities, the prompt lists them as an exhaustive set and forbids additional instruments.
sents.zh: 如果某个来源提供了仪器的身份标识，提示会将它们列为完整集合，并禁止添加其他仪器。

sents.en: If only detector-derived instrument counts are available, the prompt constrains the number of instruments mentioned but lets the model identify their types from the video.
sents.zh: 如果仅能获取由探测器推导出的仪器数量，提示会限制提及的仪器数量，但允许模型从视频中识别其类型。

sents.en: If neither identity nor a reliable count is available, the model uses open-vocabulary descriptions and is instructed to mention only instruments that are visible.
sents.zh: 如果既没有身份标识也没有可靠的数量信息，模型将使用开放词汇描述，并被指示仅提及可见的仪器。

sents.en: Domain-appropriate instrument examples are supplied as guidance rather than as a closed label set.
sents.zh: 领域相关的仪器示例被用作指导，而非封闭的标签集合。

sents.en: This tiered design reduces unsupported tool hallucination without treating cross-domain detector predictions as ground truth.
sents.zh: 这种分层设计减少了无法支持的工具幻觉，同时不会将跨领域的探测器预测视为基准事实。

paragraphs.en: For a CholecT50 clip annotated with the triplet grasper–grasp–gallbladder , the generated caption states that the grasper holds and manipulates the gallbladder, then describes the surrounding liver and fatty tissue, the tissue surface, lighting, and camera stability. For a PitVis clip labeled nasal corridor creation , the caption identifies the current operative context, describes the sphenoid-region anatomy and minor bleeding, and explicitly states that no instrument is visible. For an OphNet clip labeled corneal incision creation , the caption identifies the keratome action, the corneal response, the iris and pupil in the background, and the close-up microscopic view. These examples illustrate how the same semantic template is instantiated across distinct surgical domains without forcing them into an identical vocabulary.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一段标注了“抓取器–抓取–胆囊”三元组的 CholecT50 视频片段，生成的字幕指出抓取器正在握住并操作胆囊，随后描述了周围的肝脏和脂肪组织、组织表面、光照以及摄像机的稳定性。 对于一段标注为“鼻腔通道创建”的 PitVis 视频片段，字幕明确了当前的手术情境，描述了蝶骨区域的结构和解剖特征以及轻微出血，并明确指出画面中没有任何器械可见。 对于一段标注为“角膜切口创建”的 OphNet 视频片段，字幕指出了角膜刀的动作、角膜的反应、背景中的虹膜和瞳孔，以及近距离的显微视角。 这些例子表明，相同的语义模板可以在不同的手术领域中被具体化，而无需将这些领域强行纳入完全相同的词汇体系中。

sents.en: For a CholecT50 clip annotated with the triplet grasper–grasp–gallbladder , the generated caption states that the grasper holds and manipulates the gallbladder, then describes the surrounding liver and fatty tissue, the tissue surface, lighting, and camera stability.
sents.zh: 对于一段标注了“抓取器–抓取–胆囊”三元组的 CholecT50 视频片段，生成的字幕指出抓取器正在握住并操作胆囊，随后描述了周围的肝脏和脂肪组织、组织表面、光照以及摄像机的稳定性。

sents.en: For a PitVis clip labeled nasal corridor creation , the caption identifies the current operative context, describes the sphenoid-region anatomy and minor bleeding, and explicitly states that no instrument is visible.
sents.zh: 对于一段标注为“鼻腔通道创建”的 PitVis 视频片段，字幕明确了当前的手术情境，描述了蝶骨区域的结构和解剖特征以及轻微出血，并明确指出画面中没有任何器械可见。

sents.en: For an OphNet clip labeled corneal incision creation , the caption identifies the keratome action, the corneal response, the iris and pupil in the background, and the close-up microscopic view.
sents.zh: 对于一段标注为“角膜切口创建”的 OphNet 视频片段，字幕指出了角膜刀的动作、角膜的反应、背景中的虹膜和瞳孔，以及近距离的显微视角。

sents.en: These examples illustrate how the same semantic template is instantiated across distinct surgical domains without forcing them into an identical vocabulary.
sents.zh: 这些例子表明，相同的语义模板可以在不同的手术领域中被具体化，而无需将这些领域强行纳入完全相同的词汇体系中。

paragraphs.en: Each captioning prompt follows a fixed compositional template: procedure and surgical context + visible instruments + instrument–action–target interaction + surrounding anatomy + tissue appearance and response + lighting and camera conditions . Available procedure, phase, step, action, and instrument metadata are inserted as constraints, while Hulu-Med-4B is instructed to describe only information supported by the metadata or visible in the clip. When instrument identities are available, they are treated as an exhaustive set; when only instrument counts are available, the number of mentioned tools is constrained; otherwise, the model uses open-vocabulary descriptions restricted to clearly visible instruments.
paragraphs.zh: 每个字幕提示都遵循一个固定的组合模板：手术程序和背景 + 可见器械 + 器械–动作–目标之间的相互作用 + 周围解剖结构 + 组织外观与反应 + 光照和相机条件。 可用的手术程序、阶段、步骤、动作和器械元数据被作为约束条件插入，同时要求 Hulu-Med-4B 仅描述由这些元数据支持或在片段中可见的信息。 当器械身份明确时，它们被视为一个完整的集合；当仅可用器械数量时，所提及工具的数量会受到限制；否则，模型会使用开放词汇的描述，但仅限于清晰可见的器械。

sents.en: Each captioning prompt follows a fixed compositional template: procedure and surgical context + visible instruments + instrument–action–target interaction + surrounding anatomy + tissue appearance and response + lighting and camera conditions .
sents.zh: 每个字幕提示都遵循一个固定的组合模板：手术程序和背景 + 可见器械 + 器械–动作–目标之间的相互作用 + 周围解剖结构 + 组织外观与反应 + 光照和相机条件。

sents.en: Available procedure, phase, step, action, and instrument metadata are inserted as constraints, while Hulu-Med-4B is instructed to describe only information supported by the metadata or visible in the clip.
sents.zh: 可用的手术程序、阶段、步骤、动作和器械元数据被作为约束条件插入，同时要求 Hulu-Med-4B 仅描述由这些元数据支持或在片段中可见的信息。

sents.en: When instrument identities are available, they are treated as an exhaustive set; when only instrument counts are available, the number of mentioned tools is constrained; otherwise, the model uses open-vocabulary descriptions restricted to clearly visible instruments.
sents.zh: 当器械身份明确时，它们被视为一个完整的集合；当仅可用器械数量时，所提及工具的数量会受到限制；否则，模型会使用开放词汇的描述，但仅限于清晰可见的器械。

paragraphs.en: We apply deterministic consistency checks after temporal extraction and captioning. Every clip must have a unique identifier, a readable video path, non-empty metadata, and a non-empty caption. The numbers of video files, metadata entries, and caption records are reconciled for every source. Captioning is checkpointed per clip and failed or empty generations are retried, allowing interrupted runs to resume without duplicating completed samples. The instrument constraints in the prompt are also derived from the same metadata record used to construct the clip, preventing cross-sample label mixing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在时间片段提取和生成字幕之后，执行确定性一致性检查。 每个片段都必须有唯一的标识符、可读的视频路径、非空的元数据以及非空的字幕。 对于每个源文件，视频文件数量、元数据条目数和字幕记录数均需进行核对。 字幕生成按片段进行分阶段检查；若生成失败或为空，则重新尝试，使中断的运行能够继续执行，而不会重复生成已完成的样本。 提示词中的工具约束也源自用于构建该片段的同一元数据记录，从而避免跨样本标签混用。

sents.en: We apply deterministic consistency checks after temporal extraction and captioning.
sents.zh: 我们在时间片段提取和生成字幕之后，执行确定性一致性检查。

sents.en: Every clip must have a unique identifier, a readable video path, non-empty metadata, and a non-empty caption.
sents.zh: 每个片段都必须有唯一的标识符、可读的视频路径、非空的元数据以及非空的字幕。

sents.en: The numbers of video files, metadata entries, and caption records are reconciled for every source.
sents.zh: 对于每个源文件，视频文件数量、元数据条目数和字幕记录数均需进行核对。

sents.en: Captioning is checkpointed per clip and failed or empty generations are retried, allowing interrupted runs to resume without duplicating completed samples.
sents.zh: 字幕生成按片段进行分阶段检查；若生成失败或为空，则重新尝试，使中断的运行能够继续执行，而不会重复生成已完成的样本。

sents.en: The instrument constraints in the prompt are also derived from the same metadata record used to construct the clip, preventing cross-sample label mixing.
sents.zh: 提示词中的工具约束也源自用于构建该片段的同一元数据记录，从而避免跨样本标签混用。

paragraphs.en: To prevent near-duplicate temporal content from leaking across partitions, the final training, validation, and test sets should be divided at the patient or source-video level before enumerating their clips. All clips originating from one case must remain in the same partition. The release manifest should report the final per-source retained counts and the case-level split used to obtain SurgActionClip-30K. SurgActionClip-30K will be made publicly available.
paragraphs.zh: 为防止近乎重复的时间内容在不同分区间泄露，在枚举片段之前，应将最终的训练集、验证集和测试集按患者或源视频级别进行划分。 所有源自同一病例的片段必须保留在同一分区中。 发布清单应报告每个来源最终保留的片段数量，以及用于生成 SurgActionClip-30K 的病例级划分方式。 SurgActionClip-30K 将向公众开放获取。

sents.en: To prevent near-duplicate temporal content from leaking across partitions, the final training, validation, and test sets should be divided at the patient or source-video level before enumerating their clips.
sents.zh: 为防止近乎重复的时间内容在不同分区间泄露，在枚举片段之前，应将最终的训练集、验证集和测试集按患者或源视频级别进行划分。

sents.en: All clips originating from one case must remain in the same partition.
sents.zh: 所有源自同一病例的片段必须保留在同一分区中。

sents.en: The release manifest should report the final per-source retained counts and the case-level split used to obtain SurgActionClip-30K.
sents.zh: 发布清单应报告每个来源最终保留的片段数量，以及用于生成 SurgActionClip-30K 的病例级划分方式。

sents.en: SurgActionClip-30K will be made publicly available.
sents.zh: SurgActionClip-30K 将向公众开放获取。

paragraphs.en: To enable fair and reproducible cross-model comparison, we construct a 200-prompt benchmark. The construction of this prompt set draws on three complementary sources, described below.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现跨模型之间的公平且可复现的比较，我们构建了一个包含 200 个提示词的基准测试集。 该提示词集的构建参考了以下三种相互补充的来源。

sents.en: To enable fair and reproducible cross-model comparison, we construct a 200-prompt benchmark.
sents.zh: 为了实现跨模型之间的公平且可复现的比较，我们构建了一个包含 200 个提示词的基准测试集。

sents.en: The construction of this prompt set draws on three complementary sources, described below.
sents.zh: 该提示词集的构建参考了以下三种相互补充的来源。

paragraphs.en: The action and procedure skeleton is grounded in BSA-10 [ 44 ] , which defines 10 Basic Surgical Actions (BSAs): Aspiration , Clipping , Coagulation , Dissection , Knot-tying , Needle Grasping , Needle Puncture , Packaging , Suture Pulling , and Tissue Retraction . These 10 actions are evaluated across 6 core surgical procedures ( Cholecystectomy , Gastrectomy , Hysterectomy , Intestinal Resection , Nephrectomy , Prostatectomy ) and 2 additional procedures reserved for external generalization testing ( VATS Lobectomy , Hepatectomy ).
paragraphs.zh: 动作与流程框架基于 BSA-10 [44]，该框架定义了 10 项基本外科动作（BSAs）：吸引、夹闭、凝固、分离、打结、持针、穿刺、包装、拉线和组织牵开。 这 10 项动作在 6 项核心外科手术（胆囊切除术、胃切除术、子宫切除术、肠道切除术、肾切除术和前列腺切除术）以及 2 项用于外部泛化测试的附加手术（视频辅助胸腔镜肺叶切除术和肝切除术）中进行了评估。

sents.en: The action and procedure skeleton is grounded in BSA-10 [ 44 ] , which defines 10 Basic Surgical Actions (BSAs): Aspiration , Clipping , Coagulation , Dissection , Knot-tying , Needle Grasping , Needle Puncture , Packaging , Suture Pulling , and Tissue Retraction .
sents.zh: 动作与流程框架基于 BSA-10 [44]，该框架定义了 10 项基本外科动作（BSAs）：吸引、夹闭、凝固、分离、打结、持针、穿刺、包装、拉线和组织牵开。

sents.en: These 10 actions are evaluated across 6 core surgical procedures ( Cholecystectomy , Gastrectomy , Hysterectomy , Intestinal Resection , Nephrectomy , Prostatectomy ) and 2 additional procedures reserved for external generalization testing ( VATS Lobectomy , Hepatectomy ).
sents.zh: 这 10 项动作在 6 项核心外科手术（胆囊切除术、胃切除术、子宫切除术、肠道切除术、肾切除术和前列腺切除术）以及 2 项用于外部泛化测试的附加手术（视频辅助胸腔镜肺叶切除术和肝切除术）中进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Fine-grained instrument–verb–target vocabulary is derived from CholecT50 triplet annotations in Cholec80 [ 27 ] , comprising 5,209 clip-caption pairs. From these annotations we identify 90 unique triplets spanning 6 instrument classes, 9 verb classes, and 14 anatomical target classes (e.g., grasper → \rightarrow grasp → \rightarrow gallbladder , clipper → \rightarrow clip → \rightarrow cystic-duct , hook → \rightarrow dissect → \rightarrow peritoneum , and irrigator → \rightarrow aspirate → \rightarrow fluid .). As these triplets originate exclusively from Cholec80, they provide annotation-grounded coverage only for the cholecystectomy subset; instrument–action–target combinations for the remaining procedures (e.g., gastrectomy, hysterectomy, lobectomy) are manually extended based on standard surgical practice rather than dataset-derived triplet annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 精细的器械–动词–目标词汇表源自 Cholec80 中 CholecT50 的三元组标注 [27]，包含 5,209 个剪辑-描述对。 通过这些标注，我们识别出 90 个独特的三元组，涵盖 6 类器械、9 类动词和 14 类解剖学目标（例如：抓钳 → \rightarrow 抓取 → \rightarrow 胆囊；夹钳 → \rightarrow 夹持 → \rightarrow 囊性导管；钩子 → \rightarrow 分离 → \rightarrow 腹膜；以及冲洗器 → \rightarrow 吸引 → \rightarrow 液体）。 由于这些三元组完全源自 Cholec80，因此它们仅对胆囊切除术子集提供基于标注的覆盖范围；其余手术（如胃切除术、子宫切除术和肺叶切除术）中的器械–动作–目标组合则是根据标准手术实践手动扩展的，而非基于数据集中提取的三元组标注。

sents.en: Fine-grained instrument–verb–target vocabulary is derived from CholecT50 triplet annotations in Cholec80 [ 27 ] , comprising 5,209 clip-caption pairs.
sents.zh: 精细的器械–动词–目标词汇表源自 Cholec80 中 CholecT50 的三元组标注 [27]，包含 5,209 个剪辑-描述对。

sents.zh: 由于这些三元组完全源自 Cholec80，因此它们仅对胆囊切除术子集提供基于标注的覆盖范围；其余手术（如胃切除术、子宫切除术和肺叶切除术）中的器械–动作–目标组合则是根据标准手术实践手动扩展的，而非基于数据集中提取的三元组标注。

paragraphs.en: Each prompt follows a fixed compositional template: subject + explicit BSA action + instrument–verb–anatomical target + surgical scene/background + visual style + aesthetic controls + optional camera language . For example: “A laparoscopic surgeon performs aspiration in a laparoscopic cholecystectomy field, using an irrigator to aspirate bile fluid pooling near the gallbladder bed after controlled perforation, tight close-up scope view, realistic surgical lighting, 4K.” Two additional constraints are enforced across all prompts: (1) every prompt includes the fixed subject phrase “A laparoscopic surgeon” to prevent video generation models from failing to recognize the endoscopic/surgical context; (2) every prompt explicitly states the BSA action label (e.g., “performs needle grasping” ) rather than leaving the action implicit in natural language.
paragraphs.zh: 每个提示都遵循一个固定的组合模板：主体 + 明确的 BSA 动作 + 器械–动词–解剖学目标 + 手术场景/背景 + 视觉风格 + 美学控制 + 可选的镜头语言。 例如：“一名腹腔镜外科医生在腹腔镜胆囊切除手术区域进行吸引操作，使用冲洗器吸取胆囊床附近因可控穿孔而积聚的胆汁，采用紧密的特写镜头视角、逼真的手术照明和 4K 画质。”所有提示都强制执行另外两个约束条件：（1）每个提示都包含固定的主体短语“一名腹腔镜外科医生”，以防止视频生成模型无法识别内窥镜/手术场景；（2）每个提示都明确说明 BSA 动作标签（例如，“执行针抓取”），而不是将动作隐含在自然语言中。

sents.en: Each prompt follows a fixed compositional template: subject + explicit BSA action + instrument–verb–anatomical target + surgical scene/background + visual style + aesthetic controls + optional camera language .

paragraphs.en: The first 180 prompts form a strict 6 × 10 × 3 6\times 10\times 3 factorial grid (6 core procedures × \times 10 BSA actions × \times 3 phrasing variants per action), while the remaining 20 prompts extend coverage to two additional organs/procedures for external generalization testing and are not organized as a complete, balanced ten-action grid. Table 4 summarizes the full distribution.

paragraphs.en: The flow action encoder is first trained on real surgical clips to learn a compact motion representation from optical-flow sequences. The decoder is optimized jointly to preserve motion information, while auxiliary objectives encourage the latent space to maintain action-discriminative structure and avoid collapse. After this stage, only the latent action encoder is retained as the motion representation module.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，在真实手术片段上训练流动作编码器，以便从光流序列中学习紧凑的动作表示。 解码器被联合优化以保留动作信息，同时辅助目标促使潜在空间保持能够区分动作的结构，并避免其坍缩。 此阶段结束后，仅保留潜在动作编码器作为动作表示模块。

sents.en: After this stage, only the latent action encoder is retained as the motion representation module.
sents.zh: 此阶段结束后，仅保留潜在动作编码器作为动作表示模块。

paragraphs.en: The flow action encoder is frozen and provides target latent action sequences for paired surgical captions. The text-to-action predictor learns to map surgical prompts into the same latent action space. Since the target latent sequence remains fixed during this stage, the predictor learns the correspondence between textual descriptions and motion priors.
paragraphs.zh: 流动作编码器被冻结，并为配对的手术描述提供目标潜在动作序列。 文本到动作预测器学习将手术提示映射到相同的潜在动作空间。 由于在此阶段目标潜在序列保持固定，预测器能够学习文本描述与运动先验之间的对应关系。

sents.zh: 流动作编码器被冻结，并为配对的手术描述提供目标潜在动作序列。

sents.en: The text-to-action predictor learns to map surgical prompts into the same latent action space.
sents.zh: 文本到动作预测器学习将手术提示映射到相同的潜在动作空间。

sents.en: Since the target latent sequence remains fixed during this stage, the predictor learns the correspondence between textual descriptions and motion priors.
sents.zh: 由于在此阶段目标潜在序列保持固定，预测器能够学习文本描述与运动先验之间的对应关系。

paragraphs.en: The action adapter is trained through the frozen video diffusion backbone. The backbone and surgical-domain LoRA remain unchanged, while gradients are propagated through the denoising process to update only the adapter parameters. During training, the adapter receives flow-derived latent actions, whereas inference replaces them with text-predicted latent actions.
paragraphs.zh: 动作适配器通过冻结的视频扩散主干网络进行训练。 主干网络和手术领域的 LoRA 保持不变，而梯度则通过去噪过程传播，仅更新适配器的参数。 在训练阶段，适配器接收由流推导出的潜在动作，而在推理阶段，这些动作会被文本预测的潜在动作所替代。

sents.zh: 动作适配器通过冻结的视频扩散主干网络进行训练。

sents.en: The backbone and surgical-domain LoRA remain unchanged, while gradients are propagated through the denoising process to update only the adapter parameters.
sents.zh: 主干网络和手术领域的 LoRA 保持不变，而梯度则通过去噪过程传播，仅更新适配器的参数。

sents.en: During training, the adapter receives flow-derived latent actions, whereas inference replaces them with text-predicted latent actions.
sents.zh: 在训练阶段，适配器接收由流推导出的潜在动作，而在推理阶段，这些动作会被文本预测的潜在动作所替代。

paragraphs.en: To further validate the generality of FLAIR’s motion improvements across different video diffusion backbones, we provide two additional temporal comparison examples, spanning HunyuanVideo-1.5 [ 42 ] and CogVideoX-2B [ 47 ] , complementing the Wan-based [ 38 ] comparison shown in the main paper (Figure 3).
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步验证 FLAIR 在运动改进方面的通用性，以及其在不同视频扩散模型主干网络上的表现，我们提供了两个额外的时序对比示例，涵盖 HunyuanVideo-1.5 [42] 和 CogVideoX-2B [47]，以补充主论文中基于 Wan 的对比（图 3）。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 5 , HunyuanVideo-1.5 LoRA-FLAIR produces anatomically plausible surgical scenes with a consistently visible, stable instrument across the full 80-frame sequence. In contrast, the LoRA-only baseline exhibits drifting instrument motion and localized structural artifacts in later frames, consistent with its higher artifact-evidence scores on the drift and instrument-deformation axes reported in Main text.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 5 所示，HunyuanVideo-1.5 LoRA-FLAIR 能够生成解剖学上合理的外科场景，并且在全部 80 帧序列中，手术器械始终清晰可见且保持稳定。 相比之下，仅使用 LoRA 的基线模型在后续帧中出现了手术器械的漂移运动以及局部结构伪影，这与主文中报告的其在漂移和器械变形轴向上的更高伪影证据分数相一致。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 5 , HunyuanVideo-1.5 LoRA-FLAIR produces anatomically plausible surgical scenes with a consistently visible, stable instrument across the full 80-frame sequence.
sents.zh: 如图 5 所示，HunyuanVideo-1.5 LoRA-FLAIR 能够生成解剖学上合理的外科场景，并且在全部 80 帧序列中，手术器械始终清晰可见且保持稳定。

sents.en: In contrast, the LoRA-only baseline exhibits drifting instrument motion and localized structural artifacts in later frames, consistent with its higher artifact-evidence scores on the drift and instrument-deformation axes reported in Main text.
sents.zh: 相比之下，仅使用 LoRA 的基线模型在后续帧中出现了手术器械的漂移运动以及局部结构伪影，这与主文中报告的其在漂移和器械变形轴向上的更高伪影证据分数相一致。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows a similar pattern for CogVideoX-2B. CogVideoX-2B LoRA-FLAIR maintains a grounded, physically anchored instrument with consistent visibility and a more stable camera view throughout the sequence, whereas the LoRA-only baseline shows the instrument intermittently disappearing, floating detached from tissue, and increasing viewpoint instability as generation progresses. These additional examples reinforce the main paper’s finding that injecting flow-derived latent action priors improves motion stability and action consistency across multiple base video diffusion architectures, rather than being specific to a single backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 图6展示了CogVideoX-2B的类似模式。 CogVideoX-2B LoRA-FLAIR在整个序列中保持一个具有物理锚定、可见性一致且视角更稳定的器械，而仅使用LoRA的基线模型则显示器械会间歇性消失、脱离组织漂浮，并随着生成过程推进导致视角越来越不稳定。 这些额外例子进一步证实了主论文的研究发现：注入基于流推导出的潜在动作先验能够提升多种基础视频扩散架构中的运动稳定性和动作一致性，而并非仅针对单一骨干网络。

sents.en: Figure 6 shows a similar pattern for CogVideoX-2B.
sents.zh: 图6展示了CogVideoX-2B的类似模式。

sents.en: CogVideoX-2B LoRA-FLAIR maintains a grounded, physically anchored instrument with consistent visibility and a more stable camera view throughout the sequence, whereas the LoRA-only baseline shows the instrument intermittently disappearing, floating detached from tissue, and increasing viewpoint instability as generation progresses.
sents.zh: CogVideoX-2B LoRA-FLAIR在整个序列中保持一个具有物理锚定、可见性一致且视角更稳定的器械，而仅使用LoRA的基线模型则显示器械会间歇性消失、脱离组织漂浮，并随着生成过程推进导致视角越来越不稳定。

sents.en: These additional examples reinforce the main paper’s finding that injecting flow-derived latent action priors improves motion stability and action consistency across multiple base video diffusion architectures, rather than being specific to a single backbone.
sents.zh: 这些额外例子进一步证实了主论文的研究发现：注入基于流推导出的潜在动作先验能够提升多种基础视频扩散架构中的运动稳定性和动作一致性，而并非仅针对单一骨干网络。

paragraphs.en: This section provides additional details on the degradation design, axis-level supervision, empirical validation, and ablation studies used to construct and validate SurgMetrics. The overall objective is to convert a small set of clean, real laparoscopic clips into a broad and systematically controlled space of surgical-domain failure modes, each targeting one or more clinically meaningful artifact axes, without relying on costly expert annotation of generated video. We first summarize the 21 controlled degradation families and their mapping onto the six prediction heads, then present validation evidence linking SurgMetrics scores to human judgments of generated surgical video quality, and finally report ablation studies examining the contribution of individual design components, including the role of optical-flow-derived motion statistics, to overall evaluator performance.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提供了有关用于构建和验证 SurgMetrics 的退化设计、轴级监督、经验验证和消融研究的更多细节。 总体目标是将一组干净的真实腹腔镜片段转换为一个广泛且系统受控的外科领域故障模式空间，其中每个故障模式都针对一个或多个具有临床意义的伪影轴，而无需依赖对生成视频进行昂贵的人工专家标注。 我们首先总结了 21 种受控的退化类型及其与六个预测头的对应关系，然后展示了将 SurgMetrics 分数与人类对生成外科视频质量的判断联系起来的验证证据，最后报告了消融研究，考察了各个设计组件（包括由光流推导出的运动统计量所起的作用）对评估者整体表现的影响。

sents.zh: 本节提供了有关用于构建和验证 SurgMetrics 的退化设计、轴级监督、经验验证和消融研究的更多细节。
