sents.en: We first summarize the 21 controlled degradation families and their mapping onto the six prediction heads, then present validation evidence linking SurgMetrics scores to human judgments of generated surgical video quality, and finally report ablation studies examining the contribution of individual design components, including the role of optical-flow-derived motion statistics, to overall evaluator performance.
sents.zh: 我们首先总结了 21 种受控的退化类型及其与六个预测头的对应关系，然后展示了将 SurgMetrics 分数与人类对生成外科视频质量的判断联系起来的验证证据，最后报告了消融研究，考察了各个设计组件（包括由光流推导出的运动统计量所起的作用）对评估者整体表现的影响。

paragraphs.en: To construct axis-specific supervision without relying on expert annotation of generated video, SurgMetrics is trained on 21 controlled synthetic degradation families applied to clean, real laparoscopic clips. Each family’s severity is routed, with a family-specific weight, to one or more of the six artifact-specific heads (Semantic, Appearance, Drift, Instrument, Tissue, Tracklet).
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不依赖对生成视频进行专家标注的情况下构建特定轴的监督机制，SurgMetrics 是在将 21 种受控的合成退化类型应用于干净的真实腹腔镜片段的基础上进行训练的。 每个退化家族的严重程度会通过一个家族特定的权重，被路由到六个特定于不同伪影的输出头（语义、外观、漂移、器械、组织、轨迹片段）中的一个或多个。

sents.en: To construct axis-specific supervision without relying on expert annotation of generated video, SurgMetrics is trained on 21 controlled synthetic degradation families applied to clean, real laparoscopic clips.
sents.zh: 为了在不依赖对生成视频进行专家标注的情况下构建特定轴的监督机制，SurgMetrics 是在将 21 种受控的合成退化类型应用于干净的真实腹腔镜片段的基础上进行训练的。

sents.en: Each family’s severity is routed, with a family-specific weight, to one or more of the six artifact-specific heads (Semantic, Appearance, Drift, Instrument, Tissue, Tracklet).
sents.zh: 每个退化家族的严重程度会通过一个家族特定的权重，被路由到六个特定于不同伪影的输出头（语义、外观、漂移、器械、组织、轨迹片段）中的一个或多个。

paragraphs.en: Table 11 summarizes the meaning and construction of each family, grouped by its primary target axis. Intuitively, the six axes target the recurring, enumerable failure modes of surgical video generation. Semantic Implausibility and Appearance Artifacts capture whether video remains visually and actionally plausible. Drift and Tracklet instability capture whether instruments and tissue remain temporally coherent across frames. Instrument and Tissue Deformation capture whether their local geometry stays physically consistent and assess the cross-frame stability of surgical motion.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 总结了每个类别的含义和构建方式，并按其主要目标轴进行了分组。 直观地说，这六个轴针对的是手术视频生成中反复出现且可枚举的故障模式。 语义不合理性和外观伪影用于判断视频在视觉和行动上是否仍然合理可信。 漂移和轨迹片段不稳定性用于判断器械和组织在各帧之间是否在时间上保持连贯一致。 器械与组织形变用于判断其局部几何结构是否保持物理一致性，并评估手术动作在各帧之间的稳定性。

sents.en: Table 11 summarizes the meaning and construction of each family, grouped by its primary target axis.
sents.zh: 表 11 总结了每个类别的含义和构建方式，并按其主要目标轴进行了分组。

sents.en: Intuitively, the six axes target the recurring, enumerable failure modes of surgical video generation.
sents.zh: 直观地说，这六个轴针对的是手术视频生成中反复出现且可枚举的故障模式。

sents.en: Semantic Implausibility and Appearance Artifacts capture whether video remains visually and actionally plausible.
sents.zh: 语义不合理性和外观伪影用于判断视频在视觉和行动上是否仍然合理可信。

sents.en: Drift and Tracklet instability capture whether instruments and tissue remain temporally coherent across frames.
sents.zh: 漂移和轨迹片段不稳定性用于判断器械和组织在各帧之间是否在时间上保持连贯一致。

sents.en: Instrument and Tissue Deformation capture whether their local geometry stays physically consistent and assess the cross-frame stability of surgical motion.
sents.zh: 器械与组织形变用于判断其局部几何结构是否保持物理一致性，并评估手术动作在各帧之间的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Table 12 reports the full routing-weight matrix from each family to the six heads. As shown in the mapping, most families are routed primarily to a single head, while a subset also contributes secondary supervision to related axes, e.g., the Instrument and Tissue families additionally inform the Tracklet head, reflecting how local instrument or tissue instability naturally manifests as tracklet-level artifacts. When designing the Drift-related families, we deliberately avoided any degradation that penalizes motion purely based on its overall speed, such as treating slower motion as higher quality or faster motion as lower quality. Real surgical videos naturally vary in pacing across surgeons, procedures, and camera viewpoints, so a fixed notion of ”correct” speed would not generalize across this variation. Instead, our temporal families (e.g., speed_distortion, motion_jerk) specifically target non-uniform, erratic, or discontinuous changes in speed within a clip, rather than penalizing any particular absolute pace.
paragraphs.zh: 表 12 报告了每个家族到六个头部的完整路由权重矩阵。 如映射所示，大多数家族主要路由到单个头部，而一部分家族还会对相关轴提供次要监督，例如，仪器和组织家族还会为 Tracklet 头部提供信息，这反映了局部仪器或组织的不稳定性如何自然地表现为 Tracklet 级别的伪影。 在设计与漂移相关的家族时，我们刻意避免了任何仅基于运动整体速度而对其施加惩罚的退化机制，例如将较慢的运动视为更高质量，或将较快的运动视为更低质量。 真实的手术视频在不同外科医生、不同手术程序和不同摄像头视角下，其节奏自然存在差异，因此一个固定的“正确”速度概念无法适用于这种多样性。 相反，我们的时间相关家族（例如 speed_distortion、motion_jerk）专门针对片段内速度不均匀、不规则或不连续的变化，而不是惩罚任何特定的绝对速度。

sents.en: Table 12 reports the full routing-weight matrix from each family to the six heads.
sents.zh: 表 12 报告了每个家族到六个头部的完整路由权重矩阵。

sents.en: As shown in the mapping, most families are routed primarily to a single head, while a subset also contributes secondary supervision to related axes, e.g., the Instrument and Tissue families additionally inform the Tracklet head, reflecting how local instrument or tissue instability naturally manifests as tracklet-level artifacts.
sents.zh: 如映射所示，大多数家族主要路由到单个头部，而一部分家族还会对相关轴提供次要监督，例如，仪器和组织家族还会为 Tracklet 头部提供信息，这反映了局部仪器或组织的不稳定性如何自然地表现为 Tracklet 级别的伪影。

sents.zh: 真实的手术视频在不同外科医生、不同手术程序和不同摄像头视角下，其节奏自然存在差异，因此一个固定的“正确”速度概念无法适用于这种多样性。

sents.en: Instead, our temporal families (e.g., speed_distortion, motion_jerk) specifically target non-uniform, erratic, or discontinuous changes in speed within a clip, rather than penalizing any particular absolute pace.
sents.zh: 相反，我们的时间相关家族（例如 speed_distortion、motion_jerk）专门针对片段内速度不均匀、不规则或不连续的变化，而不是惩罚任何特定的绝对速度。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 visualizes the qualitative effect of each of the 21 degradation families applied to a single clean reference frame, illustrating the range of surgical-specific failure modes that SurgMetrics is trained to detect.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了将 21 种退化类型分别应用于单个干净参考图像时的定性效果，阐明了 SurgMetrics 所训练用于检测的外科手术特定故障模式的范围。

paragraphs.en: We validate SurgMetrics along three complementary dimensions: sensitivity to controlled artifacts, generalization beyond the training distribution, and alignment with human perception. SurgMetrics is trained using 100,000 unique source windows sampled from five real surgical datasets, totaling 20,000 real surgical clips, and 21 controlled degradation families (Section D.1 ). All data are divided at the complete-case level, such that clips from the same surgical procedure cannot appear across training and evaluation splits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个相互补充的维度对 SurgMetrics 进行验证：对受控伪影的敏感性、超越训练分布的泛化能力，以及与人类感知的契合度。 SurgMetrics 的训练使用了从五个真实手术数据集中采样的 100,000 个唯一源窗口，总计包含 20,000 个真实手术片段，以及 21 个受控退化家族（D.1 节）。 所有数据均按完整病例级别进行划分，确保来自同一手术操作的片段不会同时出现在训练集和评估集中。

sents.en: We validate SurgMetrics along three complementary dimensions: sensitivity to controlled artifacts, generalization beyond the training distribution, and alignment with human perception.
sents.zh: 我们从三个相互补充的维度对 SurgMetrics 进行验证：对受控伪影的敏感性、超越训练分布的泛化能力，以及与人类感知的契合度。

sents.en: SurgMetrics is trained using 100,000 unique source windows sampled from five real surgical datasets, totaling 20,000 real surgical clips, and 21 controlled degradation families (Section D.1 ).
sents.zh: SurgMetrics 的训练使用了从五个真实手术数据集中采样的 100,000 个唯一源窗口，总计包含 20,000 个真实手术片段，以及 21 个受控退化家族（D.1 节）。

sents.en: All data are divided at the complete-case level, such that clips from the same surgical procedure cannot appear across training and evaluation splits.
sents.zh: 所有数据均按完整病例级别进行划分，确保来自同一手术操作的片段不会同时出现在训练集和评估集中。

paragraphs.en: For severity evaluation, we report paired- Δ \Delta Spearman correlation ρ Δ \rho_{\Delta} and clean-versus-degraded AUC. Paired- Δ \Delta correlation measures whether the score increase between a clean clip and its degraded counterpart follows the target degradation severity, thereby reducing variation caused by the original video content.
paragraphs.zh: 在严重性评估中，我们报告了配对 Δ Spearman 相关系数 ρ_{Δ} 以及干净与退化视频之间的 AUC。 配对 Δ 相关系数用于衡量干净片段与其退化版本之间的分数增长是否符合目标退化严重性，从而减少原始视频内容引起的变异。

sents.en: For severity evaluation, we report paired- Δ \Delta Spearman correlation ρ Δ \rho_{\Delta} and clean-versus-degraded AUC.
sents.zh: 在严重性评估中，我们报告了配对 Δ Spearman 相关系数 ρ_{Δ} 以及干净与退化视频之间的 AUC。

sents.en: Paired- Δ \Delta correlation measures whether the score increase between a clean clip and its degraded counterpart follows the target degradation severity, thereby reducing variation caused by the original video content.
sents.zh: 配对 Δ 相关系数用于衡量干净片段与其退化版本之间的分数增长是否符合目标退化严重性，从而减少原始视频内容引起的变异。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 5 , SurgMetrics reliably distinguishes clean clips from clips containing multiple simultaneous artifacts on previously unseen surgical cases. The high external single-artifact correlation and AUC further show that the learned axes generalize across acquisition conditions and surgical datasets. Performance remains positive for unseen combinations of multiple artifacts, although this setting is more difficult than isolated degradation. The low variation across seeds indicates that these conclusions are not determined by a particular initialization. Complementary results on domain typicality and human-alignment validation are reported in later sections.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 5 所示，SurgMetrics 能够可靠地区分干净剪片与包含多种同时出现伪影的剪片，且适用于此前未见过的手术病例。 较高的外部单伪影相关性和 AUC 进一步表明，所学习的坐标轴能够泛化到不同的采集条件和手术数据集。 对于多种伪影的未知组合，模型性能仍保持良好，尽管这种设置比单独存在的退化情况更为复杂。 不同随机种子之间的低差异表明，这些结论并非由特定的初始化方式所决定。 关于领域典型性和人类对齐验证的补充结果将在后续章节中报告。

sents.en: As shown in Table 5 , SurgMetrics reliably distinguishes clean clips from clips containing multiple simultaneous artifacts on previously unseen surgical cases.
sents.zh: 如表 5 所示，SurgMetrics 能够可靠地区分干净剪片与包含多种同时出现伪影的剪片，且适用于此前未见过的手术病例。

sents.en: The high external single-artifact correlation and AUC further show that the learned axes generalize across acquisition conditions and surgical datasets.
sents.zh: 较高的外部单伪影相关性和 AUC 进一步表明，所学习的坐标轴能够泛化到不同的采集条件和手术数据集。

sents.en: Performance remains positive for unseen combinations of multiple artifacts, although this setting is more difficult than isolated degradation.
sents.zh: 对于多种伪影的未知组合，模型性能仍保持良好，尽管这种设置比单独存在的退化情况更为复杂。

sents.en: The low variation across seeds indicates that these conclusions are not determined by a particular initialization.
sents.zh: 不同随机种子之间的低差异表明，这些结论并非由特定的初始化方式所决定。

sents.en: Complementary results on domain typicality and human-alignment validation are reported in later sections.
sents.zh: 关于领域典型性和人类对齐验证的补充结果将在后续章节中报告。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation set contains 90 generated laparoscopic videos from nine model configurations, with ten videos per configuration. The same ten prompts are used across all configurations to enable matched comparisons. All videos are anonymized and randomly shuffled, with only the corresponding prompts shown to the evaluators. Four surgeons with specialist qualifications and approximately 7–21 years of clinical experience independently rate each video on a five-point ordinal scale. The evaluation covers visible defects corresponding to the six SurgMetrics artifact dimensions, overall video quality, and the correctness of the instrument–action–target interaction specified by the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 评估集包含来自九种模型配置的 90 段生成的腹腔镜视频，每种配置提供十段视频。 所有配置均使用相同的十个提示词，以实现匹配比较。 所有视频均已匿名化并随机打乱，评估者仅能看到对应的提示词。 四名具备专业资格且拥有约 7 至 21 年临床经验的外科医生，独立地用五点序数量表对每段视频进行评分。 评估内容涵盖与 SurgMetrics 缺陷六个维度相对应的可见缺陷、整体视频质量，以及提示词所指定的器械–动作–目标交互的正确性。

sents.en: The evaluation set contains 90 generated laparoscopic videos from nine model configurations, with ten videos per configuration.
sents.zh: 评估集包含来自九种模型配置的 90 段生成的腹腔镜视频，每种配置提供十段视频。

sents.en: The same ten prompts are used across all configurations to enable matched comparisons.

sents.zh: 评估内容涵盖与 SurgMetrics 缺陷六个维度相对应的可见缺陷、整体视频质量，以及提示词所指定的器械–动作–目标交互的正确性。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether SurgMetrics captures native generation failures beyond the synthetic degradations used for training, we compare each SurgMetrics artifact axis directly with the corresponding human rating rather than constructing an aggregate score across heterogeneous axes. Spearman rank correlations range from 0.746 to 0.867 across the six axes, indicating strong positive rank agreement between SurgMetrics and the corresponding human judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 SurgMetrics 是否捕捉到了超出训练所用合成退化之外的原生生成失败，我们将每个 SurgMetrics 指标轴直接与相应的人类评分进行比较，而不是在不同性质的指标轴上构建一个综合得分。 在六个指标轴上，Spearman 等级相关系数范围从 0.746 到 0.867，表明 SurgMetrics 与相应的人类判断之间存在强烈的正向等级一致性。

sents.en: To evaluate whether SurgMetrics captures native generation failures beyond the synthetic degradations used for training, we compare each SurgMetrics artifact axis directly with the corresponding human rating rather than constructing an aggregate score across heterogeneous axes.
sents.zh: 为了评估 SurgMetrics 是否捕捉到了超出训练所用合成退化之外的原生生成失败，我们将每个 SurgMetrics 指标轴直接与相应的人类评分进行比较，而不是在不同性质的指标轴上构建一个综合得分。

sents.en: Spearman rank correlations range from 0.746 to 0.867 across the six axes, indicating strong positive rank agreement between SurgMetrics and the corresponding human judgments.
sents.zh: 在六个指标轴上，Spearman 等级相关系数范围从 0.746 到 0.867，表明 SurgMetrics 与相应的人类判断之间存在强烈的正向等级一致性。

paragraphs.en: We assess the consistency of the human ratings using a two-way random-effects, absolute-agreement ICC for the mean of four raters (ICC(2,4)) [ 17 ] . Reliability ranges from 0.721 to 0.832 across the artifact axes, while ICC values for action correctness range from 0.742 to 0.825, indicating generally good inter-rater reliability. We further examine the effect of model identity. The correlation with overall human-rated quality decreases from 0.845 to 0.731 after adjustment, while remaining strong, indicating that the observed association is not solely explained by differences among model configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用双因素随机效应绝对一致性ICC（针对四名评分者的均值，即ICC(2,4)）[17]来评估人类评分的一致性。 各人工制品轴上的可靠性范围在0.721至0.832之间，而动作正确性的ICC值则在0.742至0.825之间，表明评分者间一致性总体良好。 我们进一步考察模型身份的影响。 调整后的相关性从0.845降至0.731，但仍保持较强水平，这表明观察到的关联并非完全由模型配置间的差异所解释。

paragraphs.en: Action correctness is assessed independently from SurgMetrics by asking the surgeons to evaluate whether the instrument–action–target interaction specified by each prompt is correctly executed. Across all three video backbones, FLAIR receives lower mean interaction-error ratings than the corresponding LoRA baseline, with paired confidence intervals excluding zero. This direct human assessment complements the artifact-oriented SurgMetrics evaluation and supports consistent improvements in action execution across the three backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 动作正确性由外科医生独立于 SurgMetrics 进行评估，即要求他们判断每个提示所指定的器械–动作–目标交互是否被正确执行。 在所有三种视频主干模型中，FLAIR 获得的平均交互错误评分均低于对应的 LoRA 基线模型，且配对置信区间不包含零。 这种直接的人类评估补充了以人为错误为导向的 SurgMetrics 评估，并支持三种主干模型中动作执行的一致性改进。

paragraphs.en: To provide practical reference points for interpreting the domain-typicality score, we evaluate the domain-distance branch of SurgMetrics on five datasets spanning a deliberate spectrum from in-domain laparoscopic video to fully out-of-domain general video, using 100 clips per dataset. Table 6 reports the mean robust z z -score and the AUROC of separating each dataset from in-domain unseen test clips.
paragraphs.zh: 为了为解释领域典型性分数提供实际的参考点，我们使用每个数据集 100 个片段，在五个涵盖从领域内腹腔镜视频到完全领域外通用视频的有意跨度数据集上评估 SurgMetrics 的领域距离分支。 表 6 报告了将每个数据集与领域内未见测试片段区分开的平均稳健 z 分数和 AUROC。

sents.en: To provide practical reference points for interpreting the domain-typicality score, we evaluate the domain-distance branch of SurgMetrics on five datasets spanning a deliberate spectrum from in-domain laparoscopic video to fully out-of-domain general video, using 100 clips per dataset.
sents.zh: 为了为解释领域典型性分数提供实际的参考点，我们使用每个数据集 100 个片段，在五个涵盖从领域内腹腔镜视频到完全领域外通用视频的有意跨度数据集上评估 SurgMetrics 的领域距离分支。

sents.en: Table 6 reports the mean robust z z -score and the AUROC of separating each dataset from in-domain unseen test clips.
sents.zh: 表 6 报告了将每个数据集与领域内未见测试片段区分开的平均稳健 z 分数和 AUROC。

paragraphs.en: These results order datasets exactly as expected given their surgical relatedness. PhaKIR and SLAM, both near-domain laparoscopic datasets, remain closest to the training distribution (robust z z of 1.85 and 1.96, still separable from in-domain unseen test but far below the datasets that follow). OphNet, a semi-related surgical domain (ophthalmic surgery, sharing instrument-tissue interaction structure but differing anatomy and imaging setup), sits at an intermediate distance (3.60). SurgVU24, a robotic-surgery dataset with substantially different visual and platform characteristics, and UCF101, a fully unrelated general-domain action-recognition dataset, are pushed furthest from the training distribution (4.99 and 5.82, respectively), confirming that the domain-distance branch correctly separates genuinely out-of-surgical-domain content from surgical video that merely differs in sub-specialty.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果完全按照数据集之间的手术相关性预期对它们进行了排序。 PhaKIR 和 SLAM 都是近领域腹腔镜数据集，它们与训练分布保持最接近（稳健的 z 值为 1.85 和 1.96，仍然可以与领域内未见过的测试数据区分开，但远低于后续的数据集）。 OphNet 是一个半相关的手术领域（眼科手术，共享器械-组织交互结构，但解剖结构和成像设置不同），其距离处于中等水平（3.60）。 SurgVU24 是一个机器人手术数据集，其视觉和平台特性与训练数据有显著差异；而 UCF101 则是一个完全无关的通用领域动作识别数据集。这两个数据集被推离训练分布最远（分别为 4.99 和 5.82），这证实了领域距离分支能够正确区分真正属于手术域外的内容，与仅在亚专科上有所不同的手术视频。

paragraphs.en: Based on this progression and consistent with the domain-distance threshold of 4 used in the main paper to exclude out-of-domain clips from SurgMetrics comparisons, we suggest the following coarse interpretation bands: values below approximately 2 indicate in-domain or near-domain laparoscopic content (e.g., PhaKIR, SLAM); values in the intermediate range (roughly 2–4) indicate semi-related surgical domains that are typologically surgical but visually or anatomically distinct (e.g., OphNet); and values above 4 indicate content that has departed the surgical laparoscopic distribution to a degree where SurgMetrics artifact scores are no longer meaningful for comparison (e.g., SurgVU24, UCF101), consistent with our exclusion criterion in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一演变过程，并且与主论文中用于排除 SurgMetrics 比较中域外剪辑的 4 的领域距离阈值一致，我们建议采用以下粗略的解释区间：低于约 2 的值表示属于该领域或接近该领域的腹腔镜内容（例如 PhaKIR、SLAM）；中间范围（大致为 2–4）的值表示半相关的手术领域，这些领域在类型上属于手术范畴，但在视觉或解剖结构上存在差异（例如 OphNet）；高于 4 的值则表示已偏离手术腹腔镜分布的内容，其程度使得 SurgMetrics 的伪影评分不再具有比较意义（例如 SurgVU24、UCF101），这与主论文中的排除标准一致。

paragraphs.en: It is important to emphasize that a higher robust z z -score reflects greater distributional distance from the training domain, not more severe generation artifacts; domain typicality and the six artifact-specific heads are deliberately reported as independent, non-substitutable signals. A clip can be domain-typical while still exhibiting severe artifacts, or domain-atypical while visually clean, and conflating the two would misrepresent what each score is designed to measure.
paragraphs.zh: 需要强调的是，较高的稳健 z z -分数反映的是与训练域更大的分布距离，而非更严重的生成伪影；域的典型性与六个特定于伪影的指标被刻意报告为相互独立且不可替代的信号。 一个片段可能属于域的典型样本，但仍表现出严重的伪影；也可能不属于域的典型样本，但视觉上却干净无瑕疵。将两者混为一谈会错误地呈现每个分数所设计要测量的内容。

paragraphs.en: SurgMetrics fuses two input branches before predicting the six artifact heads: a SurgViSTA [ 46 ] visual-feature leg and a 25-dimensional Farneback optical-flow leg [ 9 ] . To isolate each branch’s contribution, we compare Full (both legs fused), SurgViSTA-only, and Optical-only, all trained under identical data splits, epochs, seeds (42/43/44), and evaluation cohorts (1,500 held-out multi-degradation records, 1,122 external records, 1,200 clean validation records for threshold calibration).
paragraphs.zh: SurgMetrics 在预测六个伪影头部之前，融合了两个输入分支：一个 SurgViSTA [ 46 ] 视觉特征分支和一个 25 维 Farneback 光流分支 [ 9 ]。 为了分离每个分支的贡献，我们比较了 Full（两个分支融合）、SurgViSTA-only 和 Optical-only 模型；所有模型均在相同的数据划分、训练轮次、随机种子（42/43/44）以及评估数据集（1,500 条保留的多退化记录、1,122 条外部记录、1,200 条用于阈值校准的干净验证记录）下训练。

sents.zh: SurgMetrics 在预测六个伪影头部之前，融合了两个输入分支：一个 SurgViSTA [ 46 ] 视觉特征分支和一个 25 维 Farneback 光流分支 [ 9 ]。

sents.zh: 为了分离每个分支的贡献，我们比较了 Full（两个分支融合）、SurgViSTA-only 和 Optical-only 模型；所有模型均在相同的数据划分、训练轮次、随机种子（42/43/44）以及评估数据集（1,500 条保留的多退化记录、1,122 条外部记录、1,200 条用于阈值校准的干净验证记录）下训练。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 7 , full achieves the best score on every aggregate metric. Relative to SurgViSTA-only, adding the optical-flow leg costs only 9,024 extra parameters yet yields consistent gains across all aggregate metrics, most notably +0.1373 Spearman on the external single-family cohort, while relative to Optical-only, adding the SurgViSTA leg yields substantially larger gains (e.g., +0.3209 held-out multi Spearman, +0.2768 held-out AUC), confirming SurgViSTA as the primary semantic/visual backbone that the optical leg alone cannot replace.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 7 所示，full 在每个汇总指标上都取得了最佳分数。 与仅使用 SurgViSTA 的方案相比，添加光流分支仅增加 9,024 个额外参数，却能在所有汇总指标上带来一致的提升，尤其是在外部单户住宅队列中，Spearman 相关系数提升了 +0.1373；而与仅使用光学流的方案相比，添加 SurgViSTA 分支则带来了显著更大的提升（例如，测试集多指标 Spearman 相关系数提升 +0.3209，测试集 AUC 提升 +0.2768），这证实了 SurgViSTA 是主要提供语义/视觉主干能力的模块，仅靠光学流分支无法替代。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 isolates the clearest per-axis signal, Drift. SurgViSTA-only trails Full by 0.2250 in adapter test accuracy and 0.1731 in internal Spearman, while Optical-only alone retains a comparatively strong Drift correlation (0.5235) despite far fewer parameters and no visual semantics. This indicates that optical features primarily complement SurgViSTA by supplying temporal-motion evidence, with the strongest gain concentrated in drift-related evaluation, whereas SurgViSTA alone cannot fully capture motion-timing artifacts and optical features alone cannot sustain full six-axis evaluation capability.
paragraphs.zh: 表 8 单独展示了每个轴上最清晰的信号：漂移。 在适配器测试准确率方面，仅使用 SurgViSTA 的模型比 Full 模型低 0.2250，在内部 Spearman 相关系数方面低 0.1731；而仅使用 Optical 的模型尽管参数数量远少且没有视觉语义信息，仍保持了相对较强的漂移相关性（0.5235）。 这表明光学特征主要通过提供时间-运动证据来补充 SurgViSTA，其中最强的增益集中在与漂移相关的评估中；而单独使用 SurgViSTA 无法完全捕捉运动-时间伪影，单独使用光学特征也无法维持完整的六轴评估能力。

paragraphs.en: We adapted three pretrained text-to-video models—Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 38 ] , HunyuanVideo-1.5 T2V (8.3B) [ 42 ] , and CogVideoX-2B [ 47 ] —using low-rank adaptation (LoRA). For a frozen linear projection W W , LoRA parameterizes the update as W ′ = W + ( α / r ) ​ B ​ A W^{\prime}=W+(\alpha/r)BA , where r r is the rank. Only the LoRA parameters were optimized, while the pretrained video backbone, VAE, and text encoders remained frozen. We used a LoRA rank of r = 32 r=32 and scaling parameter α = 1 \alpha=1 for all three models. The training videos were paired with detailed English captions describing the surgical instruments, actions, anatomy, and visual context.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用低秩适配（LoRA）方法对三种预训练文本到视频模型进行了适配——Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 38 ]、HunyuanVideo-1.5 T2V（8.3B）[ 42 ] 和 CogVideoX-2B [ 47 ]。 对于一个固定的线性投影矩阵 W，LoRA 将更新参数化为 W′ = W + ( α / r ) ​ B ​ A，其中 r 是秩。 仅对 LoRA 参数进行了优化，而预训练的视频主干网络、VAE 和文本编码器则保持冻结。 我们对所有三种模型都使用了秩为 r = 32 的 LoRA 和缩放参数 α = 1。 训练视频与详细的英文字幕配对，这些字幕描述了手术器械、操作、解剖结构和视觉背景。

sents.zh: 训练视频与详细的英文字幕配对，这些字幕描述了手术器械、操作、解剖结构和视觉背景。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tuned the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B model using the Wan LoRA architecture provided by Musubi Tuner. The LoRA parameters were randomly initialized and trained directly from scratch on top of the pretrained Wan backbone; no previously trained adapter or optimizer state was used. LoRA layers were applied to the linear projections in the transformer’s attention blocks. Training was performed for four epochs using six GPUs with data parallelism, a per-GPU batch size of 1, and gradient accumulation over two steps, resulting in an effective batch size of 12. We used 8-bit AdamW with a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , a maximum gradient norm of 1.0, and random seed 42. The majority of training samples contained 81 frames at 480 × 832 480\times 832 pixels, while short clips contained 33 frames. Shifted timestep sampling with a discrete flow shift of 3.0 was used. Training was conducted with BF16 mixed precision, FP8 backbone weights, scaled-dot-product attention, and gradient checkpointing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Musubi Tuner 提供的 Wan LoRA 架构对 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型进行了微调。 LoRA 参数被随机初始化，并直接在预训练的 Wan 主干网络基础上从头开始训练；未使用任何预先训练好的适配器或优化器状态。 LoRA 层被应用于变换器注意力模块中的线性投影。 训练持续了四个周期，使用了六块 GPU 进行数据并行，每块 GPU 的批量大小为 1，并进行了两步梯度累积，最终得到有效的批量大小为 12。 我们使用了 8-bit AdamW，设置恒定的学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁴，最大梯度范数为 1.0，随机种子为 42。 大多数训练样本包含 81 帧、分辨率为 480 × 832 像素的图像，而短片段则包含 33 帧。 我们采用了带有 3.0 离散流偏移的时步偏移采样方法。 训练过程中使用了 BF16 混合精度、FP8 主干网络权重、缩放点积注意力以及梯度检查点机制。

sents.en: We fine-tuned the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B model using the Wan LoRA architecture provided by Musubi Tuner.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Musubi Tuner 提供的 Wan LoRA 架构对 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型进行了微调。

sents.en: The LoRA parameters were randomly initialized and trained directly from scratch on top of the pretrained Wan backbone; no previously trained adapter or optimizer state was used.
sents.zh: LoRA 参数被随机初始化，并直接在预训练的 Wan 主干网络基础上从头开始训练；未使用任何预先训练好的适配器或优化器状态。

sents.en: LoRA layers were applied to the linear projections in the transformer’s attention blocks.
sents.zh: LoRA 层被应用于变换器注意力模块中的线性投影。

sents.en: Training was performed for four epochs using six GPUs with data parallelism, a per-GPU batch size of 1, and gradient accumulation over two steps, resulting in an effective batch size of 12.
sents.zh: 训练持续了四个周期，使用了六块 GPU 进行数据并行，每块 GPU 的批量大小为 1，并进行了两步梯度累积，最终得到有效的批量大小为 12。

sents.en: We used 8-bit AdamW with a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , a maximum gradient norm of 1.0, and random seed 42.
sents.zh: 我们使用了 8-bit AdamW，设置恒定的学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁴，最大梯度范数为 1.0，随机种子为 42。

sents.en: The majority of training samples contained 81 frames at 480 × 832 480\times 832 pixels, while short clips contained 33 frames.
sents.zh: 大多数训练样本包含 81 帧、分辨率为 480 × 832 像素的图像，而短片段则包含 33 帧。

sents.en: Shifted timestep sampling with a discrete flow shift of 3.0 was used.
sents.zh: 我们采用了带有 3.0 离散流偏移的时步偏移采样方法。

sents.en: Training was conducted with BF16 mixed precision, FP8 backbone weights, scaled-dot-product attention, and gradient checkpointing.
sents.zh: 训练过程中使用了 BF16 混合精度、FP8 主干网络权重、缩放点积注意力以及梯度检查点机制。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tuned the 720p T2V variant of HunyuanVideo 1.5 using its dedicated LoRA architecture in Musubi Tuner. This model employs a multimodal diffusion transformer together with a video VAE and Qwen2.5-VL and ByT5 text-conditioning branches. The LoRA parameters were initialized from scratch and inserted into the model’s multimodal transformer blocks. Training was performed for three epochs using six-GPU data parallelism, a per-GPU batch size of 1, and two-step gradient accumulation, giving an effective batch size of 12. We used 8-bit AdamW with a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , gradient clipping at 1.0, and seed 42. Videos were trained primarily as 81-frame clips at 320 × 576 320\times 576 pixels, with 33-frame windows used for shorter clips. We adopted shifted timestep sampling without additional loss weighting and used a discrete flow shift of 2.0. BF16 mixed precision, scaled FP8 backbone weights, scaled-dot-product attention, and gradient checkpointing were enabled during training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Musubi Tuner 中其专用的 LoRA 架构，对 HunyuanVideo 1.5 的 720p T2V 变体进行了微调。 该模型采用了一种多模态扩散变换器，并结合了视频 VAE、Qwen2.5-VL 以及 ByT5 文本条件分支。 LoRA 参数从零开始初始化，并插入到模型的多模态变换器块中。 训练过程持续三个周期，采用六 GPU 的数据并行方式，每个 GPU 的批量大小为 1，并进行两步梯度累积，从而得到有效的批量大小为 12。 我们使用了 8-bit AdamW，学习率恒定为 1 × 10⁻⁴，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0，并设置了随机种子为 42。 视频训练主要基于 320 × 576 像素的 81 帧片段进行，较短片段则使用 33 帧的窗口。 我们采用了偏移时间步采样，未添加额外的损失加权，并使用了 2.0 的离散流偏移。 训练过程中启用了 BF16 混合精度、缩放 FP8 主干权重、缩放点积注意力以及梯度检查点机制。

sents.en: We fine-tuned the 720p T2V variant of HunyuanVideo 1.5 using its dedicated LoRA architecture in Musubi Tuner.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Musubi Tuner 中其专用的 LoRA 架构，对 HunyuanVideo 1.5 的 720p T2V 变体进行了微调。

sents.en: This model employs a multimodal diffusion transformer together with a video VAE and Qwen2.5-VL and ByT5 text-conditioning branches.
sents.zh: 该模型采用了一种多模态扩散变换器，并结合了视频 VAE、Qwen2.5-VL 以及 ByT5 文本条件分支。

sents.en: The LoRA parameters were initialized from scratch and inserted into the model’s multimodal transformer blocks.
sents.zh: LoRA 参数从零开始初始化，并插入到模型的多模态变换器块中。

sents.en: Training was performed for three epochs using six-GPU data parallelism, a per-GPU batch size of 1, and two-step gradient accumulation, giving an effective batch size of 12.
sents.zh: 训练过程持续三个周期，采用六 GPU 的数据并行方式，每个 GPU 的批量大小为 1，并进行两步梯度累积，从而得到有效的批量大小为 12。

sents.en: We used 8-bit AdamW with a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , gradient clipping at 1.0, and seed 42.
sents.zh: 我们使用了 8-bit AdamW，学习率恒定为 1 × 10⁻⁴，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0，并设置了随机种子为 42。

sents.en: Videos were trained primarily as 81-frame clips at 320 × 576 320\times 576 pixels, with 33-frame windows used for shorter clips.
sents.zh: 视频训练主要基于 320 × 576 像素的 81 帧片段进行，较短片段则使用 33 帧的窗口。

sents.en: We adopted shifted timestep sampling without additional loss weighting and used a discrete flow shift of 2.0.
sents.zh: 我们采用了偏移时间步采样，未添加额外的损失加权，并使用了 2.0 的离散流偏移。

sents.en: BF16 mixed precision, scaled FP8 backbone weights, scaled-dot-product attention, and gradient checkpointing were enabled during training.
sents.zh: 训练过程中启用了 BF16 混合精度、缩放 FP8 主干权重、缩放点积注意力以及梯度检查点机制。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tuned CogVideoX-2B using the Hugging Face FineTrainers architecture, which integrates the Diffusers implementation of CogVideoX with PEFT-based LoRA training. CogVideoX uses a latent video transformer conditioned on T5 text features and a 3D VAE for video encoding and decoding. LoRA was applied to the query, key, value, and output projections of the transformer attention layers. Training used six-GPU data parallelism with a per-GPU batch size of 1 and two-step gradient accumulation, yielding an effective batch size of 12. The videos were resampled to 16 fps and organized into 81-frame and 33-frame resolution buckets. We used AdamW with a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , gradient clipping at 1.0, and seed 42. The model was trained in BF16 with gradient checkpointing, and the 6,500-step LoRA checkpoint was selected for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Hugging Face FineTrainers 架构对 CogVideoX-2B 进行了微调，该架构将 CogVideoX 的 Diffusers 实现与基于 PEFT 的 LoRA 训练相结合。 CogVideoX 采用了一种以 T5 文本特征为条件的潜在视频变换器，并借助 3D VAE 进行视频编码和解码。 LoRA 被应用于变换器注意力层的查询、键、值以及输出投影部分。 训练过程中采用了六 GPU 的数据并行处理，每个 GPU 的批量大小为 1，并进行了两步梯度累积，从而得到有效的批量大小为 12。 视频被重新采样至 16 fps，并按分辨率分入 81 帧和 33 帧的分组中。 我们使用了 AdamW 优化器，设置恒定的学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁴，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0，并设定了随机种子为 42。 模型以 BF16 格式进行训练并启用了梯度检查点机制，最终用于评估的是包含 6,500 步的 LoRA 检查点。

sents.en: We fine-tuned CogVideoX-2B using the Hugging Face FineTrainers architecture, which integrates the Diffusers implementation of CogVideoX with PEFT-based LoRA training.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Hugging Face FineTrainers 架构对 CogVideoX-2B 进行了微调，该架构将 CogVideoX 的 Diffusers 实现与基于 PEFT 的 LoRA 训练相结合。

sents.en: CogVideoX uses a latent video transformer conditioned on T5 text features and a 3D VAE for video encoding and decoding.
sents.zh: CogVideoX 采用了一种以 T5 文本特征为条件的潜在视频变换器，并借助 3D VAE 进行视频编码和解码。

sents.en: LoRA was applied to the query, key, value, and output projections of the transformer attention layers.
sents.zh: LoRA 被应用于变换器注意力层的查询、键、值以及输出投影部分。

sents.en: Training used six-GPU data parallelism with a per-GPU batch size of 1 and two-step gradient accumulation, yielding an effective batch size of 12.
sents.zh: 训练过程中采用了六 GPU 的数据并行处理，每个 GPU 的批量大小为 1，并进行了两步梯度累积，从而得到有效的批量大小为 12。

sents.en: The videos were resampled to 16 fps and organized into 81-frame and 33-frame resolution buckets.
sents.zh: 视频被重新采样至 16 fps，并按分辨率分入 81 帧和 33 帧的分组中。

sents.en: We used AdamW with a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , gradient clipping at 1.0, and seed 42.
sents.zh: 我们使用了 AdamW 优化器，设置恒定的学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁴，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0，并设定了随机种子为 42。

sents.en: The model was trained in BF16 with gradient checkpointing, and the 6,500-step LoRA checkpoint was selected for evaluation.
sents.zh: 模型以 BF16 格式进行训练并启用了梯度检查点机制，最终用于评估的是包含 6,500 步的 LoRA 检查点。

paragraphs.en: The final Flow Action Encoder (FAE) uses checkpoint step 10,000, with a 128-dimensional latent and 128 × \times 128 training resolution. Input flow images are stored as 3 × \times 256 × \times 256 uint8, normalized to [ − 0.5 , 0.5 ] [-0.5,0.5] , and bilinearly resized to 3 × \times 128 × \times 128. Each 80-position flow window is sampled as a pair of positions 40 apart, i ∼ Uniform ​ { 0 , … , 39 } i\sim\mathrm{Uniform}\{0,\dots,39\} and i + 40 i+40 , per training step.
paragraphs.zh: 最终的流动作编码器（FAE）使用第 10,000 个检查点步骤，其潜在维度为 128，训练分辨率为 128 × 128。 输入流图像存储为 3 × 256 × 256 的 uint8 格式，归一化至 [−0.5, 0.5]，并通过双线性插值缩放至 3 × 128 × 128。 在每个训练步骤中，每个包含 80 个位置的流窗口都会被采样为一对间隔为 40 的位置：i ∼ Uniform{0, …, 39} 和 i + 40。

sents.en: The final Flow Action Encoder (FAE) uses checkpoint step 10,000, with a 128-dimensional latent and 128 × \times 128 training resolution.
sents.zh: 最终的流动作编码器（FAE）使用第 10,000 个检查点步骤，其潜在维度为 128，训练分辨率为 128 × 128。

sents.en: Input flow images are stored as 3 × \times 256 × \times 256 uint8, normalized to [ − 0.5 , 0.5 ] [-0.5,0.5] , and bilinearly resized to 3 × \times 128 × \times 128.
sents.zh: 输入流图像存储为 3 × 256 × 256 的 uint8 格式，归一化至 [−0.5, 0.5]，并通过双线性插值缩放至 3 × 128 × 128。

sents.en: Each 80-position flow window is sampled as a pair of positions 40 apart, i ∼ Uniform ​ { 0 , … , 39 } i\sim\mathrm{Uniform}\{0,\dots,39\} and i + 40 i+40 , per training step.
sents.zh: 在每个训练步骤中，每个包含 80 个位置的流窗口都会被采样为一对间隔为 40 的位置：i ∼ Uniform{0, …, 39} 和 i + 40。

paragraphs.en: The encoder is a convolutional stack (3 × \times 128 × \times 128 → \to 24 → \to 24 → \to 48 → \to 96 → \to 192 → \to 384 → \to 768 channels, halving spatial resolution at each stage down to 1 × \times 1) followed by a linear projection to 128 dimensions and L2 normalization; the decoder mirrors this structure in reverse, ending with a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution and a tanh / 2 \tanh/2 output. The full model has 7,399,103 parameters, and encoding a full window yields Z ∈ ℝ 80 × 128 Z\in\mathbb{R}^{80\times 128} .
paragraphs.zh: 编码器是一个卷积堆叠（3 × \times 128 × \times 128 → \to 24 → \to 24 → \to 48 → \to 96 → \to 192 → \to 384 → \to 768 通道，每个阶段空间分辨率减半，最终降至 1 × \times 1），随后进行线性投影至 128 维并执行 L2 归一化；解码器以相反顺序复制这一结构，最终以一个 3 × 3 3\times 3 卷积和 tanh / 2 \tanh/2 输出结束。 完整模型包含 7,399,103 个参数，对完整窗口进行编码可得到 Z ∈ ℝ 80 × 128 Z\in\mathbb{R}^{80\times 128}。

sents.en: The encoder is a convolutional stack (3 × \times 128 × \times 128 → \to 24 → \to 24 → \to 48 → \to 96 → \to 192 → \to 384 → \to 768 channels, halving spatial resolution at each stage down to 1 × \times 1) followed by a linear projection to 128 dimensions and L2 normalization; the decoder mirrors this structure in reverse, ending with a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution and a tanh / 2 \tanh/2 output.
sents.zh: 编码器是一个卷积堆叠（3 × \times 128 × \times 128 → \to 24 → \to 24 → \to 48 → \to 96 → \to 192 → \to 384 → \to 768 通道，每个阶段空间分辨率减半，最终降至 1 × \times 1），随后进行线性投影至 128 维并执行 L2 归一化；解码器以相反顺序复制这一结构，最终以一个 3 × 3 3\times 3 卷积和 tanh / 2 \tanh/2 输出结束。

sents.en: The full model has 7,399,103 parameters, and encoding a full window yields Z ∈ ℝ 80 × 128 Z\in\mathbb{R}^{80\times 128} .
sents.zh: 完整模型包含 7,399,103 个参数，对完整窗口进行编码可得到 Z ∈ ℝ 80 × 128 Z\in\mathbb{R}^{80\times 128}。

paragraphs.en: We train for 10,000 steps on 4 GPUs (DDP) with AdamW (lr 1e-4, weight decay 0.01, BF16 precision, gradient clipping 20), 32 windows per GPU (128 global windows / 256 flow images per step), seed 42, validating every 1,000 steps. Training uses hierarchical sampling (dataset → \to action → \to case → \to window) across five surgical datasets, with dataset sampling probabilities of 0.306 (Cholec80 [ 35 ] ), 0.252 (M2CAI16), 0.206 (AutoLaparo [ 41 ] ), 0.211 (HeiCo), and 0.024 (SurgicalActions160 [ 30 ] ), over 43,013 training / 8,256 validation / 7,266 held-out test windows. Checkpoint step 10,000 is selected based on downstream motion utility measured by a frozen world-model probe, rather than reconstruction error alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 4 块 GPU（DDP）上使用 AdamW（学习率 1e-4、权重衰减 0.01、BF16 精度、梯度裁剪 20）进行 10,000 步训练，每块 GPU 使用 32 个窗口（每步共 128 个全局窗口 / 256 张流图像），随机种子为 42，每 1,000 步验证一次。 训练采用分层采样（数据集 → \to 动作 → \to 病例 → \to 窗口）方式，覆盖五个外科手术数据集，各数据集的采样概率分别为 0.306（Cholec80 [ 35 ]）、0.252（M2CAI16）、0.206（AutoLaparo [ 41 ]）、0.211（HeiCo）和 0.024（SurgicalActions160 [ 30 ]），共涉及 43,013 个训练窗口、8,256 个验证窗口和 7,266 个预留测试窗口。 基于下游运动效用（通过冻结的世界模型探针测量）而非仅凭重建误差，选择第 10,000 步的检查点。

sents.en: We train for 10,000 steps on 4 GPUs (DDP) with AdamW (lr 1e-4, weight decay 0.01, BF16 precision, gradient clipping 20), 32 windows per GPU (128 global windows / 256 flow images per step), seed 42, validating every 1,000 steps.
sents.zh: 我们在 4 块 GPU（DDP）上使用 AdamW（学习率 1e-4、权重衰减 0.01、BF16 精度、梯度裁剪 20）进行 10,000 步训练，每块 GPU 使用 32 个窗口（每步共 128 个全局窗口 / 256 张流图像），随机种子为 42，每 1,000 步验证一次。

sents.en: Training uses hierarchical sampling (dataset → \to action → \to case → \to window) across five surgical datasets, with dataset sampling probabilities of 0.306 (Cholec80 [ 35 ] ), 0.252 (M2CAI16), 0.206 (AutoLaparo [ 41 ] ), 0.211 (HeiCo), and 0.024 (SurgicalActions160 [ 30 ] ), over 43,013 training / 8,256 validation / 7,266 held-out test windows.
sents.zh: 训练采用分层采样（数据集 → \to 动作 → \to 病例 → \to 窗口）方式，覆盖五个外科手术数据集，各数据集的采样概率分别为 0.306（Cholec80 [ 35 ]）、0.252（M2CAI16）、0.206（AutoLaparo [ 41 ]）、0.211（HeiCo）和 0.024（SurgicalActions160 [ 30 ]），共涉及 43,013 个训练窗口、8,256 个验证窗口和 7,266 个预留测试窗口。

sents.en: Checkpoint step 10,000 is selected based on downstream motion utility measured by a frozen world-model probe, rather than reconstruction error alone.
sents.zh: 基于下游运动效用（通过冻结的世界模型探针测量）而非仅凭重建误差，选择第 10,000 步的检查点。

paragraphs.en: The text-to-action predictor pairs a frozen Long-CLIP-L text encoder with a non-autoregressive Transformer decoder, trained to regress the frozen FAE latent sequence. Input captions are tokenized (max 248 tokens) and pooled by frozen Long-CLIP-L into a 768-dim embedding; the target is the frozen FAE z z sequence [ 80,128 ] [80,128] . Only the predictor is trained; Long-CLIP remains entirely frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到动作预测器将一个冻结的 Long-CLIP-L 文本编码器与一个非自回归的 Transformer 解码器配对，并训练其回归预测冻结的 FAE 潜在序列。 输入描述经过分词（最多 248 个词元），并通过冻结的 Long-CLIP-L 池化为一个 768 维嵌入；目标为冻结的 FAE z z 序列 [ 80,128 ] [80,128] 。 仅训练预测器；Long-CLIP 保持完全冻结。

sents.en: The text-to-action predictor pairs a frozen Long-CLIP-L text encoder with a non-autoregressive Transformer decoder, trained to regress the frozen FAE latent sequence.
sents.zh: 文本到动作预测器将一个冻结的 Long-CLIP-L 文本编码器与一个非自回归的 Transformer 解码器配对，并训练其回归预测冻结的 FAE 潜在序列。

sents.en: Input captions are tokenized (max 248 tokens) and pooled by frozen Long-CLIP-L into a 768-dim embedding; the target is the frozen FAE z z sequence [ 80,128 ] [80,128] .
sents.zh: 输入描述经过分词（最多 248 个词元），并通过冻结的 Long-CLIP-L 池化为一个 768 维嵌入；目标为冻结的 FAE z z 序列 [ 80,128 ] [80,128] 。

sents.en: Only the predictor is trained; Long-CLIP remains entirely frozen.
sents.zh: 仅训练预测器；Long-CLIP 保持完全冻结。

paragraphs.en: The pooled text embedding is projected (768 → \to 256) into a single context token, which conditions 80 learned temporal queries through a 4-layer Transformer decoder (hidden dim 256, 4 heads, FFN dim 1024, dropout 0.1); a final linear layer (256 → \to 128) with per-position L2 normalization produces the predicted sequence Z ^ ∈ ℝ 80 × 128 \hat{Z}\in\mathbb{R}^{80\times 128} . All 80 positions are predicted in parallel, not autoregressively.
paragraphs.zh: 池化后的文本嵌入被投影（768 → \to 256）为一个单一上下文标记，该标记通过一个4层Transformer解码器（隐藏维度256、4个头、FFN维度1024、dropout为0.1）对80个可学习的时序查询进行条件约束；最后的一个线性层（256 → \to 128）配合每个位置的L2归一化，生成预测序列 Z ^ ∈ ℝ 80 × 128 \hat{Z}\in\mathbb{R}^{80\times 128}。 所有80个位置都是并行预测的，而非自回归方式。

sents.en: The pooled text embedding is projected (768 → \to 256) into a single context token, which conditions 80 learned temporal queries through a 4-layer Transformer decoder (hidden dim 256, 4 heads, FFN dim 1024, dropout 0.1); a final linear layer (256 → \to 128) with per-position L2 normalization produces the predicted sequence Z ^ ∈ ℝ 80 × 128 \hat{Z}\in\mathbb{R}^{80\times 128} .
sents.zh: 池化后的文本嵌入被投影（768 → \to 256）为一个单一上下文标记，该标记通过一个4层Transformer解码器（隐藏维度256、4个头、FFN维度1024、dropout为0.1）对80个可学习的时序查询进行条件约束；最后的一个线性层（256 → \to 128）配合每个位置的L2归一化，生成预测序列 Z ^ ∈ ℝ 80 × 128 \hat{Z}\in\mathbb{R}^{80\times 128}。

sents.en: All 80 positions are predicted in parallel, not autoregressively.
sents.zh: 所有80个位置都是并行预测的，而非自回归方式。

paragraphs.en: We train on a single GPU with AdamW (fixed lr 3e-4, weight decay 1e-4), batch size 64 (validation batch 128), for up to 10,000 steps (gradient clipping 1.0, seed 42), validating and saving every 500 steps using the same train/validation/test window split as the FAE (43,013 / 8,256 / 7,266). Model selection uses validation frame-level cosine similarity; the best checkpoint occurs at step 500.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在单 GPU 上使用 AdamW（固定学习率 3e-4，权重衰减 1e-4）、批量大小 64（验证批量 128），训练最多 10,000 步（梯度裁剪 1.0，随机种子 42），每 500 步进行一次验证和保存，并使用与 FAE 相同的训练/验证/测试窗口划分（43,013 / 8,256 / 7,266）。 模型选择基于验证集上的帧级余弦相似度；最佳检查点在步骤 500 时出现。

sents.zh: 我们在单 GPU 上使用 AdamW（固定学习率 3e-4，权重衰减 1e-4）、批量大小 64（验证批量 128），训练最多 10,000 步（梯度裁剪 1.0，随机种子 42），每 500 步进行一次验证和保存，并使用与 FAE 相同的训练/验证/测试窗口划分（43,013 / 8,256 / 7,266）。

sents.zh: 模型选择基于验证集上的帧级余弦相似度；最佳检查点在步骤 500 时出现。

paragraphs.en: All three backbones (Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, HunyuanVideo 1.5, CogVideoX-2B) share a common motion-side interface: the FAE/predictor latent [ B , 80 , 128 ] [B,80,128] is mean-pooled every 4 positions to [ B , 20 , 128 ] [B,20,128] , followed by LayerNorm and a SiLU MLP (128 → \to 512 → \to 512) producing a global condition and a temporal frame bias. Adapters are trained using real z z extracted from real optical flow, but at inference use predicted z z generated from the caption; the video backbone and surgical LoRA are frozen throughout, with only the adapter updated. All three adapters inject conditioning at the input level (global/time-bias addition), rather than through per-block cross-attention.
paragraphs.zh: 所有三种主干模型（Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、HunyuanVideo 1.5、CogVideoX-2B）都共享一个共同的运动侧接口：FAE/预测器潜在表示 [ B , 80 , 128 ] [B,80,128] 每 4 个位置进行一次均值池化，得到 [ B , 20 , 128 ] [B,20,128]，随后经过 LayerNorm 和一个 SiLU MLP（128 → \to 512 → \to 512），生成全局条件和时序帧偏差。 适配器使用从真实光流中提取的真实 z z 进行训练，但在推理阶段则使用从标题生成的预测 z z；视频主干模型和手术 LoRA 在整个过程中保持冻结，仅更新适配器。 所有三种适配器都在输入层注入条件（全局/时间偏差的加法），而不是通过每个块的交叉注意力实现。

paragraphs.en: All adapters are trained with AdamW (lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4), per-GPU batch size 1, gradient clipping 1.0, BF16 precision, and seed 42, using 1,024 training samples (128 validation samples for Hunyuan/CogVideoX).
paragraphs.zh: 所有适配器均使用 AdamW（学习率 1e-4，权重衰减 1e-4）进行训练，每 GPU 的批量大小为 1，梯度裁剪值为 1.0，精度为 BF16，随机种子为 42，并使用 1,024 个训练样本（Hunyuan/CogVideoX 使用 128 个验证样本）。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 summarizes the injection dimensionality, trainable parameters, training budget, and deployment settings for each backbone. The Wan adapter (1.9M parameters) injects a 1536-dim global condition and [ B , 20 , 1536 ] [B,20,1536] temporal bias into the time embedding and patch-embedding features, trained for 1,000 steps on a single GPU at 480 × \times 832 resolution; step 500 is selected over step 1,000 for deployment (scale 0.30). The Hunyuan adapter (2.4M parameters) injects a 2048-dim condition into transformer.time_in and transformer.img_in , with the 20-position temporal bias linearly interpolated to the 21 VAE latent time positions; it is trained on 4 GPUs (DDP) at 320 × \times 576 resolution for the full 1,000 steps (deployment scale 0.50). The CogVideoX adapter (1.6M parameters) injects a 512-dim global condition and [ B , 20 , 1920 ] [B,20,1920] temporal bias into the video-token portion of the patch embedding only (excluding text tokens); the final paper-facing branch pairs the adapter with a surgical LoRA (rank 32, effective scale 1/32), trained on 8 GPUs (DDP) at 480 × \times 832 resolution, with the final deployed checkpoint at step 400 (scale 0.50).
paragraphs.zh: 表9总结了每种主干网络的注入维度、可训练参数、训练预算和部署设置。 Wan适配器（190万参数）将1536维的全局条件和[B, 20, 1536]时间偏置注入到时间嵌入和块嵌入特征中，在单GPU上以480 × 832分辨率训练1000步；部署时选择第500步而非第1000步（缩放比例0.30）。 Hunyuan适配器（240万参数）将2048维的条件注入到transformer.time_in和transformer.img_in中，其中20个位置的时间偏置被线性插值到21个VAE潜在时间位置；它在4块GPU（DDP）上以320 × 576分辨率训练全部1000步（部署缩放比例0.50）。 CogVideoX适配器（160万参数）仅将512维的全局条件和[B, 20, 1920]时间偏置注入到块嵌入的视频令牌部分（不包括文本令牌）；最终用于发表的分支将该适配器与一个手术级LoRA（秩32，有效缩放比例1/32）配对，在8块GPU（DDP）上以480 × 832分辨率训练，最终部署的检查点位于第400步（缩放比例0.50）。

paragraphs.en: SurgMetrics is trained in two stages: a SurgViSTA backbone adaptation stage, followed by a lightweight fusion model trained on frozen, cached features. The system is not trained end-to-end; SurgViSTA is first adapted and frozen before the fusion MLP is trained on top of its cached outputs.
paragraphs.zh: SurgMetrics 的训练分为两个阶段：首先是 SurgViSTA 骨干网络的适应阶段，随后是使用冻结的缓存特征训练的轻量级融合模型。 该系统并非端到端训练；首先对 SurgViSTA 进行适应并冻结，然后在其缓存输出之上训练融合 MLP。

sents.en: SurgMetrics is trained in two stages: a SurgViSTA backbone adaptation stage, followed by a lightweight fusion model trained on frozen, cached features.
sents.zh: SurgMetrics 的训练分为两个阶段：首先是 SurgViSTA 骨干网络的适应阶段，随后是使用冻结的缓存特征训练的轻量级融合模型。

sents.en: The system is not trained end-to-end; SurgViSTA is first adapted and frozen before the fusion MLP is trained on top of its cached outputs.
sents.zh: 该系统并非端到端训练；首先对 SurgViSTA 进行适应并冻结，然后在其缓存输出之上训练融合 MLP。

paragraphs.en: Starting from the pretrained SurgViSTA backbone, we fine-tune only the last 4 Transformer blocks and fc_norm , keeping earlier blocks frozen, with a temporary 768 → \to 256 → \to 6 prediction head (GELU, dropout 0.2) used solely for adaptation. Training uses AdamW with a backbone learning rate of 1e-5 and head learning rate of 3e-4 (no scheduler), weight decay 1e-4, BF16 autocast, gradient clipping 1.0, and Smooth L1 loss ( β = 0.1 \beta{=}0.1 ), for 6 epochs at seed 42. Training follows a curriculum: the first 2 epochs use only clean and single-degradation records (20,400 total), after which all 30,000 training records (clean, single, double, triple degradations) are used from epoch 3 onward. Effective batch size varies with available GPUs (5 for epoch 1, 8 for epochs 2–6, via PyTorch DDP/NCCL), with total training time of approximately 11.5 hours. Model selection uses mean-axis Spearman correlation across the six heads on a fixed 6,000-record validation set; epoch 5 (0.5066) is selected as the best checkpoint, narrowly outperforming epoch 3 (0.4983) and epoch 6 (0.4999).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从预训练的 SurgViSTA 主干网络开始，仅对最后 4 个 Transformer 块和 fc_norm 进行微调，并保持前面的块冻结；同时使用一个临时的 768 → \to 256 → \to 6 预测头（GELU，dropout 0.2），仅用于适应。 训练采用 AdamW 优化器，主干网络的学习率为 1e-5，预测头的学习率为 3e-4（无调度器），权重衰减为 1e-4，使用 BF16 自动混合精度计算，梯度裁剪值为 1.0，并采用 Smooth L1 损失函数（β = 0.1 \beta{=}0.1），在随机种子为 42 的情况下训练 6 个周期。 训练遵循一种课程学习策略：前 2 个周期仅使用干净和单级退化的记录（共 20,400 条）；从第 3 个周期开始，则使用全部 30,000 条训练记录（包括干净、单级、双级和三級退化数据）。 有效批量大小随可用 GPU 数量而变化（第 1 个周期为 5，第 2–6 个周期为 8，通过 PyTorch DDP/NCCL 实现），总训练时间约为 11.5 小时。 模型选择基于固定验证集（6,000 条记录）上六个预测头的均值轴斯皮尔曼相关系数；第 5 个周期（0.5066）被选为最佳检查点，其表现略优于第 3 个周期（0.4983）和第 6 个周期（0.4999）。

sents.zh: 我们从预训练的 SurgViSTA 主干网络开始，仅对最后 4 个 Transformer 块和 fc_norm 进行微调，并保持前面的块冻结；同时使用一个临时的 768 → \to 256 → \to 6 预测头（GELU，dropout 0.2），仅用于适应。

paragraphs.en: The fusion model takes frozen 768-dim SurgViSTA features and 25-dim Farneback optical-flow features as input, projecting each through a small branch (SurgViSTA: 768 → \to 256; Optical: 25 → \to 32, both with GELU) before concatenation (288-dim) and a shared MLP (288 → \to 256 → \to 128, GELU, dropout 0.2), followed by six independent heads (128 → \to 64 → \to 1, GELU, dropout 0.1) producing raw, unbounded scores for Semantic, Appearance, Drift, Instrument, Tissue, and Tracklet. With only 354,502 trainable parameters, training is fast (10–14 seconds/epoch) using cached features. We train for 30 epochs with AdamW, initial learning rate 3e-4 with cosine annealing to 0, weight decay 1e-4, batch size 256, and gradient clipping 5.0; ranking loss is disabled (weight 0). A curriculum similarly restricts the first 5 epochs to clean and single-degradation records (68,000) before introducing the full 100,000-record set (including double and triple degradations) from epoch 6 onward. The primary model uses seed 42, with seeds 43 and 44 used for reproducibility checks; early stopping (patience 6) is used during development but disabled for the final release run to guarantee all 30 epochs complete.
paragraphs.zh: 融合模型以冻结的 768 维 SurgViSTA 特征和 25 维 Farneback 光流特征为输入，在拼接（288 维）之前，通过一个小型分支对每个特征进行投影（SurgViSTA：768 → \to 256；Optical：25 → \to 32，两者均使用 GELU），然后接入共享的 MLP（288 → \to 256 → \to 128，GELU，dropout 0.2），接着是六个独立输出头（128 → \to 64 → \to 1，GELU，dropout 0.1），分别生成语义、外观、漂移、器械、组织和轨迹片段等指标的原始无界分数。 由于仅包含 354,502 个可训练参数，使用缓存特征进行训练时速度很快（每轮 10–14 秒）。 我们使用 AdamW 优化器进行 30 轮训练，初始学习率为 3e-4，并通过余弦退火降至 0，权重衰减为 1e-4，批量大小为 256，梯度裁剪值为 5.0；排名损失被禁用（权重为 0）。 课程学习策略同样将前 5 轮训练限制在干净且仅含单一退化类型的记录（68,000 条）上，从第 6 轮开始引入完整的 100,000 条记录数据集（包括双重和三重退化类型）。 主模型使用种子值 42，并使用种子值 43 和 44 进行可重复性验证；在开发阶段采用提前停止策略（耐心值 6），但在最终发布运行中将其禁用，以确保全部 30 轮训练完成。

paragraphs.en: All splits are performed at the case level (split seed 43) across five source datasets (Cholec80 action, AutoLaparo, M2CAI16, SurgicalActions160, HeiCo), ensuring no procedure appears across train/validation/test. From 20,000 unique real source windows, each augmented with 5 degradation variants, we obtain 100,000 training records. Training severity is sampled continuously, s ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.15 , 1.00 ) s\sim\mathcal{U}(0.15,1.00) , while validation uses fixed severity levels (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00) over 1,200 unique source windows (6,000 records total). When multiple degradations co-occur, per-axis labels are aggregated via noisy-OR, y a = 1 − ∏ i ( 1 − s i ​ w i , a ) y_{a}=1-\prod_{i}(1-s_{i}w_{i,a}) , consistent with the routing weights in Table 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有划分均在病例层面（分裂种子为 43）针对五个源数据集（Cholec80 action、AutoLaparo、M2CAI16、SurgicalActions160、HeiCo）进行，确保任何手术流程不会同时出现在训练集、验证集和测试集中。 我们从 20,000 个独特的真实源窗口中获取数据，每个窗口经过 5 种退化变体的增强处理后，共得到 100,000 条训练记录。 训练时的严重程度通过连续采样获得，s ∼ 𝒰⁡(0.15, 1.00)，而验证集则使用固定的严重程度等级（0.00、0.25、0.50、0.75、1.00），覆盖 1,200 个独特的源窗口（总计 6,000 条记录）。 当多种退化同时出现时，各轴标签通过噪声-或门进行聚合：yₐ = 1 − ∏ᵢ(1 − sᵢwᵢ,ₐ)，这与表 11 中的路由权重一致。

paragraphs.en: All quantitative results are generated using a shared prompt set of 200 surgical prompts ( prompt_set_v2 ), with every video generated at 81 frames and seed 42. Across all three backbones, the three FLAIR variants (Base-only, LoRA-only, LoRA-FLAIR) share identical resolution, frame count, FPS, denoising steps, guidance scale, seed, and LoRA weights within each backbone; the only difference introduced by LoRA-FLAIR relative to LoRA-only is the addition of the action adapter and the predicted motion latent. All three backbones further condition on the same cached [ 80,128 ] [80,128] prompt- z z produced by the shared Long-CLIP predictor. Backbone-native settings such as resolution, FPS, denoising steps, guidance scale, scheduler, LoRA scale, and adapter scale otherwise follow each backbone’s own validated configuration, summarized in Table 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有定量结果均使用包含 200 个手术提示词的共同提示词集（prompt_set_v2）生成，每个视频均以 81 帧和种子值 42 生成。 在所有三种骨干网络中，三种 FLAIR 变体（仅 Base、仅 LoRA、LoRA-FLAIR）在每种骨干网络内部共享相同的分辨率、帧数、FPS、去噪步数、引导尺度、种子值和 LoRA 权重；LoRA-FLAIR 相对于仅 LoRA 的唯一区别是增加了动作适配器和预测的运动潜在变量。 所有三种骨干网络还进一步以由共享的 Long-CLIP 预测器生成的相同缓存的 [80,128] [80,128] 提示词-z-z 为条件。 骨干网络固有的设置，如分辨率、FPS、去噪步数、引导尺度、调度器、LoRA 尺度和适配器尺度，则遵循每种骨干网络自身经过验证的配置，这些配置总结于表 10。

paragraphs.en: We use Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B with the FlowUniPCMultistepScheduler, 20 denoising steps, guidance scale 5.0, and flow shift 5.0, at 832 × \times 480 resolution with torch attention and FP8 backbone precision; the surgical LoRA is applied at multiplier 1.0, and the trained adapter (step 500) is applied at scale 0.30. No explicit negative prompt is passed, so the backbone’s default negative prompt is used.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B，搭配 FlowUniPCMultistepScheduler、20 步降噪、引导尺度 5.0 和流偏移 5.0，在 832 × 480 分辨率下运行，采用 torch attention 和 FP8 骨干网络精度；手术 LoRA 以 1.0 的乘数应用，而训练好的适配器（第 500 步）则以 0.30 的尺度应用。 未传入任何显式的负向提示，因此使用了骨干网络的默认负向提示。

sents.en: We use Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B with the FlowUniPCMultistepScheduler, 20 denoising steps, guidance scale 5.0, and flow shift 5.0, at 832 × \times 480 resolution with torch attention and FP8 backbone precision; the surgical LoRA is applied at multiplier 1.0, and the trained adapter (step 500) is applied at scale 0.30.

paragraphs.en: We use HunyuanVideo-1.5 720p T2V at 576 × \times 320 resolution, 24 FPS, 30 denoising steps, guidance scale 6.0, and flow shift 2.0, with torch attention, FP8-scaled backbone precision, and inference block swap disabled (block swapping is used only during training for memory management, not at inference). The surgical LoRA is applied at multiplier 1.0, the trained adapter (step 1,000) at scale 0.50, and the negative prompt is left empty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 HunyuanVideo-1.5 720p T2V，分辨率为 576 × 320，帧率为 24 FPS，降噪步数为 30，引导系数为 6.0，流偏移为 2.0，并启用 torch attention、FP8 缩放骨干网络精度，同时禁用推理块交换（块交换仅在训练期间用于内存管理，推理时不使用）。 手术 LoRA 的乘数设为 1.0，训练好的适配器（步骤 1,000）的比例设为 0.50，且负向提示保持为空。

paragraphs.en: We use CogVideoX-2B with the CogVideoXDDIMScheduler, 50 denoising steps, guidance scale 6.0, and BF16 pipeline precision, at 832 × \times 480 resolution and 16 FPS, with dynamic CFG disabled and no negative prompt. paragraphs.en: We evaluate the generated videos using five general metrics: VideoCLIP score, Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [ 11 ] , Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) [ 37 ] , temporal intersection over union (TI), and area fluctuation (AF). The same frozen preprocessing, model checkpoints, and reference distribution are used for all generation methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用五个通用指标来评估生成的视频：VideoCLIP 分数、Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）[ 11 ]、Fréchet Video Distance（FVD）[ 37 ]、时间交并比（TI）以及面积波动（AF）。 所有生成方法均使用相同的冻结预处理、模型检查点和参考分布。

sents.en: We evaluate the generated videos using five general metrics: VideoCLIP score, Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [ 11 ] , Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) [ 37 ] , temporal intersection over union (TI), and area fluctuation (AF).
sents.zh: 我们使用五个通用指标来评估生成的视频：VideoCLIP 分数、Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）[ 11 ]、Fréchet Video Distance（FVD）[ 37 ]、时间交并比（TI）以及面积波动（AF）。

sents.en: The same frozen preprocessing, model checkpoints, and reference distribution are used for all generation methods.
sents.zh: 所有生成方法均使用相同的冻结预处理、模型检查点和参考分布。

paragraphs.en: VideoCLIP evaluates the semantic alignment between a generated video and its conditioning prompt. Each video is decoded at 30 frames per second, resized while preserving its aspect ratio, and center-cropped to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . The official VideoCLIP video and text encoders are then used to obtain pooled representations 𝐯 i \mathbf{v}_{i} and 𝐭 i \mathbf{t}_{i} . The score for video i i is the native VideoCLIP retrieval score
paragraphs.zh: VideoCLIP 评估生成视频与其条件提示之间的语义对齐程度。 每个视频以每秒 30 帧的速率解码，在保持宽高比的同时调整大小，并以中心裁剪的方式处理为 224 × 224 224\times 224。 随后使用官方的 VideoCLIP 视频和文本编码器获取池化表示 𝐯 i \mathbf{v}_{i} 和 𝐭 i \mathbf{t}_{i}。 视频 i 的得分是原始的 VideoCLIP 检索得分。

sents.zh: VideoCLIP 评估生成视频与其条件提示之间的语义对齐程度。

sents.zh: 每个视频以每秒 30 帧的速率解码，在保持宽高比的同时调整大小，并以中心裁剪的方式处理为 224 × 224 224\times 224。

sents.en: The official VideoCLIP video and text encoders are then used to obtain pooled representations 𝐯 i \mathbf{v}_{i} and 𝐭 i \mathbf{t}_{i} .

sents.en: The score for video i i is the native VideoCLIP retrieval score
sents.zh: 视频 i 的得分是原始的 VideoCLIP 检索得分。

paragraphs.en: We report the mean score over all videos. A higher VideoCLIP score indicates better semantic consistency between the generated content and the input prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了所有视频的平均得分。 更高的 VideoCLIP 得分表示生成的内容与输入提示之间的语义一致性更好。

We construct a unified reference containing 400 held-out real surgical clips, each with 81 frames, and use the same reference statistics for every generator. Both distances follow the Fréchet distance between the real and generated feature distributions:

sents.en: Both distances follow the Fréchet distance between the real and generated feature distributions:

paragraphs.zh: 其中 𝝁 \bm{\mu} 和 𝚺 \bm{\Sigma} 分别表示特征均值和协方差。

paragraphs.en: FID is computed using pytorch-fid==0.3.0 and 2048-dimensional Inception-v3 pool3 features. We uniformly sample six frames at indices { 0 , 16 , 32 , 48 , 64 , 80 } \{0,16,32,48,64,80\} from each video. FID primarily measures frame-level visual fidelity and diversity, such as the realism of anatomy, instruments, texture, and color. FVD is computed using cd-fvd==0.1.1 and a Kinetics-400 pretrained I3D encoder [ 4 ] , with all 81 frames used jointly. It therefore measures both visual realism and temporal dynamics. Lower FID and FVD values indicate that the generated distribution is closer to the real surgical-video distribution.
paragraphs.zh: FID 是使用 pytorch-fid==0.3.0 和 2048 维的 Inception-v3 pool3 特征计算得出的。 我们从每个视频中以索引 { 0 , 16 , 32 , 48 , 64 , 80 } \{0,16,32,48,64,80\} 均匀采样六帧。 FID 主要衡量帧级别的视觉保真度和多样性，例如解剖结构、器械、纹理和颜色的逼真程度。 FVD 是使用 cd-fvd==0.1.1 和一个在 Kinetics-400 上预训练的 I3D 编码器 [ 4 ] 计算得出的，其中所有 81 帧被联合使用。 因此，它同时衡量了视觉逼真度和时间动态性。 FID 和 FVD 值越低，表示生成的分布越接近真实手术视频的分布。

sents.en: FID is computed using pytorch-fid==0.3.0 and 2048-dimensional Inception-v3 pool3 features.

paragraphs.en: A lower AF indicates smoother and more stable temporal evolution of instrument size, whereas a higher AF reflects sudden scale changes, shape instability, or instrument appearance and disappearance. Notably, in the comparison of FLAIR models with the LoRA-only models and the base models, CogVideoX-2B LoRA showed a significantly abnormal AF value even when a certain surgical environment and instruments were already apparent. This illustrates the inadequacy of general metrics in the surgical field and further emphasizes the importance of Surgmetrics.
paragraphs.zh: 较低的AF值表示器械尺寸的时序演化更为平滑和稳定，而较高的AF值则反映出尺度的突然变化、形状的不稳定性，或器械的出现与消失。 值得注意的是，在将FLAIR模型与仅使用LoRA的模型及基础模型进行比较时，CogVideoX-2B LoRA模型即使在特定手术环境和器械已经清晰可见的情况下，仍显示出明显异常的AF值。 这表明通用指标在手术领域存在不足，并进一步凸显了Surgmetrics的重要性。

paragraphs.en: FLAIR is designed as a reference-free framework that infers a plausible, text-conditioned motion prior rather than enforcing a single, user-specified action trajectory. Since a surgical prompt can admit multiple clinically valid motion realizations (e.g., varying grasp angles or interaction durations for the same instrument–action–target triplet), our text-to-action predictor is explicitly formulated to output a distributional prior Z ^ \hat{Z} that captures the canonical execution pattern learned from real surgical videos, rather than committing to an arbitrary frame-level trajectory (Eq. 9 in main paper). This design choice is intentional: by constraining generation to the compact, action-conditioned region observed in real data, FLAIR already substantially narrows the space of plausible outputs compared to unconstrained text-to-video generation, as reflected in its improved motion stability and action consistency (Table 1, Table 2 in main paper). Nonetheless, offering more explicit, trajectory- or keyframe-level steering on top of this learned prior, while preserving the reference-free inference setting, remains a natural extension for future work.
paragraphs.zh: FLAIR 被设计为一个无需参考的框架，它推断出一种合理的、由文本条件约束的运动先验，而不是强制执行单一的用户指定动作轨迹。 由于一个手术提示可以包含多种临床有效的运动实现方式（例如，对于相同的器械–动作–目标三元组，抓握角度或交互时长可能不同），我们的文本到动作预测器被明确设计为输出一个分布先验 Z ^ \hat{Z}，以捕捉从真实手术视频中学习到的典型执行模式，而不是锁定在任意的帧级轨迹上（主论文中的公式 9）。 这一设计选择是有意为之：通过将生成限制在真实数据中观察到的紧凑的、由动作条件约束的区域，FLAIR 已经显著缩小了合理输出空间，与无约束的文本到视频生成相比，这一点体现在其更优的运动稳定性和动作一致性上（主论文中的表 1、表 2）。 尽管如此，在保留无需参考的推理设置的前提下，在此学习到的先验之上提供更明确的轨迹或关键帧级引导，仍然是未来工作的一个自然延伸。

paragraphs.en: SurgActionClip-30K is built by consolidating 11 diverse surgical datasets under the cross-specialty BSA-10 taxonomy [ 44 ] , which was deliberately chosen for its broad coverage across laparoscopic, endoscopic, and microsurgical procedures and its validated use in cross-specialty action and skill assessment. This already provides substantially wider procedural and anatomical coverage than prior action-centric surgical datasets, spanning 6 core procedures plus 2 held-out procedures used explicitly to test generalization beyond the training taxonomy (Table 1). As with any taxonomy-driven dataset construction, motion priors learned within this scope may transfer less directly to action types or surgical modalities not represented in the source data; extending coverage to additional taxonomies and modalities is a straightforward and complementary direction, facilitated by FLAIR’s modular design in which new action priors can be learned without modifying the frozen video backbone.
paragraphs.zh: SurgActionClip-30K 是通过整合 11 个多样化的手术数据集构建而成的，这些数据集均遵循跨专科的 BSA-10 分类体系 [44]。该分类体系之所以被特意选用，是因为其广泛覆盖了腹腔镜、内窥镜和显微外科手术，并且已在跨专科的动作与技能评估中得到了验证。 这已经比此前以动作为核心的手术数据集提供了更广泛的手术程序和解剖学覆盖范围，涵盖了 6 项核心手术以及 2 项专门用于测试模型能否超越训练分类体系进行泛化的预留手术（表 1）。 与任何基于分类体系的构建数据集一样，在此范围内学习到的动作先验可能无法直接迁移到源数据中未涵盖的动作类型或手术方式；将覆盖范围扩展至更多分类体系和手术方式是简单且互补的发展方向，而 FLAIR 的模块化设计使得无需修改冻结的视频主干网络即可学习新的动作先验，从而为这一扩展提供了便利。

paragraphs.en: FLAIR and SurgActionClip-30K are intended to support surgical education, simulation, and data augmentation in settings where real annotated surgical video is scarce or costly to obtain [ 8 , 16 ] , while SurgMetrics aims to give the community a standardized, surgery-aware way to evaluate progress in this emerging area. Together, these three contributions point toward a future in which surgical video generation can scale beyond small, curated datasets and manually inspected results, lowering the barrier for institutions with limited resources to build simulation and training pipelines. We emphasize that FLAIR-generated videos and their SurgMetrics scores are intended as research and educational tools rather than validated clinical resources, and any real-world deployment should include expert oversight and clear labeling of synthetic content.
paragraphs.zh: FLAIR 和 SurgActionClip-30K 旨在为手术教育、模拟和数据增强提供支持，适用于真实标注手术视频稀缺或获取成本高昂的场景 [8, 16]；而 SurgMetrics 则致力于为该领域提供一个标准化且具备手术感知能力的进展评估方法。 这三项贡献共同指向一个未来：手术视频生成将能够超越小型的精选数据集和人工审核的结果，从而降低资源有限机构构建模拟与训练流程的门槛。 我们强调，FLAIR 生成的视频及其 SurgMetrics 评分仅作为研究和教育工具，而非经过验证的临床资源；任何实际部署均应包含专家监督以及对合成内容的明确标注。
